# ===== 보조정보원장 V1.1 · KIS주원장 + LS독립검증 + 보조정보비차단 =====
COPY <<'CTX_LEDGER_V11_MODULE_20261104' /app/context_ledger_sidecar.py
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
from __future__ import annotations
import hashlib, json, logging, os, re, sqlite3, threading, time
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, as_completed
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import parse_qs, quote_plus, urlparse
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET
import requests

KST = timezone(timedelta(hours=9))
LOG = logging.getLogger("context_ledger")


def now_kst(): return datetime.now(KST)
def now_iso(): return now_kst().isoformat(timespec="seconds")
def _bool(name, default=False):
    v=os.getenv(name, "true" if default else "false").strip().lower(); return v in {"1","true","yes","y","on"}
def _int(name, default):
    try: return int(os.getenv(name, str(default)))
    except Exception: return default

def _clean_text(s):
    s=re.sub(r"<[^>]+>", " ", str(s or "")); s=re.sub(r"\s+", " ", s).strip(); return s[:500]
def _hash(*parts): return hashlib.sha256("\x1f".join(str(x or "") for x in parts).encode("utf-8","ignore")).hexdigest()

def _google_rss(q):
    return "https://news.google.com/rss/search?q="+quote_plus(q)+"&hl=ko&gl=KR&ceid=KR:ko"

BROKERS = "키움증권 OR NH투자증권 OR 미래에셋증권 OR 삼성증권 OR 한국투자증권 OR KB증권 OR 신한투자증권 OR 하나증권"
DEFAULT_SOURCES = [
    {"group":"BROKER","name":"GOOGLE_NEWS_BROKER_RESEARCH","kind":"rss","url":_google_rss(f"({BROKERS}) (리포트 OR 목표가 OR 추천 OR 관심종목 OR 투자의견) when:1d")},
    {"group":"PORTAL","name":"GOOGLE_NEWS_KR_MARKET","kind":"rss","url":_google_rss("(코스피 OR 코스닥 OR 국내증시 OR 한국증시 OR 주식시장) when:1d")},
    {"group":"PORTAL","name":"NAVER_STOCK_NEWS","kind":"html","url":"https://stock.naver.com/news/section"},
    {"group":"MEDIA","name":"GOOGLE_NEWS_MAJOR_MEDIA","kind":"rss","url":_google_rss("(site:hankyung.com OR site:mk.co.kr OR site:sedaily.com OR site:edaily.co.kr OR site:mt.co.kr) (증시 OR 종목 OR 주식 OR 투자) when:1d")},
]

class ContextLedger:
    def __init__(self):
        self.enabled=_bool("CONTEXT_LEDGER_ENABLED", True)
        self.interval=_int("CONTEXT_LEDGER_INTERVAL_SECONDS",600)
        self.timeout=_int("CONTEXT_LEDGER_HTTP_TIMEOUT",12)
        self.retries=_int("CONTEXT_LEDGER_RETRIES",3)
        self.max_workers=_int("CONTEXT_LEDGER_MAX_WORKERS",6)
        self.max_items_source=_int("CONTEXT_LEDGER_MAX_ITEMS_PER_SOURCE",80)
        self.retention_runs=_int("CONTEXT_LEDGER_RETENTION_RUNS",36)
        self.db_path=Path(os.getenv("CONTEXT_LEDGER_DB_PATH","/data/context_ledger/context_ledger.db"))
        self.db_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        self.lock=threading.RLock(); self.run_lock=threading.Lock(); self.last_error=None; self.last_run_id=None
        self.market_ledger_base=os.getenv("MARKET_LEDGER_BASE","https://quant-signal-v3-7-51-clean2.onrender.com").rstrip("/")
        self.sources=self._sources(); self._init_db()
        self.ls_status_provider=None
        self.ls_result_provider=None
    def set_ls_provider(self,status_provider=None,result_provider=None):
        self.ls_status_provider=status_provider
        self.ls_result_provider=result_provider
        LOG.info("CONTEXT_LEDGER_LS_PROVIDER_BOUND status=%s result=%s",bool(status_provider),bool(result_provider))
    def _sources(self):
        src=list(DEFAULT_SOURCES)
        raw=os.getenv("CONTEXT_EXTRA_SOURCES_JSON","").strip()
        if raw:
            try:
                extra=json.loads(raw)
                if isinstance(extra,list):
                    for x in extra:
                        if isinstance(x,dict) and x.get("group") and x.get("name") and x.get("url"):
                            src.append({"group":str(x["group"]).upper(),"name":str(x["name"]),"kind":str(x.get("kind") or "rss"),"url":str(x["url"])})
            except Exception as e: LOG.warning("CONTEXT_EXTRA_SOURCES_JSON invalid: %s",e)
        return src
    def _con(self):
        c=sqlite3.connect(str(self.db_path),timeout=30,check_same_thread=False)
        c.row_factory=sqlite3.Row; c.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL"); c.execute("PRAGMA synchronous=NORMAL"); return c
    def _init_db(self):
        with self._con() as c:
            c.executescript('''
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS context_runs(
              run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,status TEXT NOT NULL,started_at TEXT,completed_at TEXT,
              source_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,ok_sources INTEGER DEFAULT 0,broker_ok INTEGER DEFAULT 0,portal_ok INTEGER DEFAULT 0,media_ok INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
              item_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,dedup_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,coverage_pct REAL DEFAULT 0,content_sha256 TEXT,error_json TEXT
            );
            CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_context_runs_ready ON context_runs(status,completed_at DESC);
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS context_items(
              id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,run_id TEXT NOT NULL,source_group TEXT NOT NULL,source_name TEXT NOT NULL,
              published_at TEXT,title TEXT NOT NULL,url TEXT,summary TEXT,item_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
              FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES context_runs(run_id)
            );
            CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_context_item ON context_items(run_id,item_hash);
            CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_context_items_run ON context_items(run_id,source_group);
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS context_source_status(
              source_name TEXT PRIMARY KEY,source_group TEXT,last_status TEXT,last_http_status INTEGER,last_success_at TEXT,last_attempt_at TEXT,
              latency_ms INTEGER,item_count INTEGER,last_error TEXT
            );
            ''')
    def _headers(self):
        return {"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; KRMarketContextLedger/1.1; +Render)","Accept":"application/rss+xml,application/xml,text/xml,text/html,application/json;q=0.9,*/*;q=0.8"}
    def _request(self,url):
        err=None
        for i in range(max(1,self.retries)):
            t=time.monotonic()
            try:
                r=requests.get(url,headers=self._headers(),timeout=self.timeout,allow_redirects=True)
                lat=int((time.monotonic()-t)*1000)
                if r.status_code>=500 or r.status_code==429:
                    err=RuntimeError(f"HTTP {r.status_code}"); time.sleep(min(4,0.5*(2**i))); continue
                r.raise_for_status(); return r,lat
            except Exception as e:
                err=e; time.sleep(min(4,0.5*(2**i)))
        raise err or RuntimeError("request failed")
    def _parse_rss(self,text):
        out=[]
        root=ET.fromstring(text)
        for node in root.findall(".//item")[:self.max_items_source]:
            title=_clean_text(node.findtext("title")); link=(node.findtext("link") or "").strip(); pub=_clean_text(node.findtext("pubDate")); desc=_clean_text(node.findtext("description"))
            if title: out.append({"title":title,"url":link,"published_at":pub,"summary":desc[:280]})
        return out
    def _parse_html(self,text):
        out=[]; seen=set()
        for m in re.finditer(r'<a[^>]+href=["\']([^"\']+)["\'][^>]*>(.*?)</a>',text,re.I|re.S):
            href=m.group(1); title=_clean_text(m.group(2))
            if len(title)<8 or title in seen: continue
            if href.startswith("/"): href="https://stock.naver.com"+href
            if not href.startswith("http"): continue
            seen.add(title); out.append({"title":title,"url":href,"published_at":"","summary":""})
            if len(out)>=self.max_items_source: break
        return out
    def _fetch_source(self,s):
        started=now_iso(); t=time.monotonic(); status="ERROR"; code=None; items=[]; err=""
        try:
            r,lat=self._request(s["url"]); code=r.status_code
            if s.get("kind")=="html": items=self._parse_html(r.text)
            else: items=self._parse_rss(r.text)
            status="OK" if items else "EMPTY"
        except Exception as e:
            lat=int((time.monotonic()-t)*1000); err=f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"
        result={**s,"status":status,"http_status":code,"latency_ms":lat,"items":items,"error":err,"attempt_at":started}
        with self._con() as c:
            c.execute('''INSERT INTO context_source_status(source_name,source_group,last_status,last_http_status,last_success_at,last_attempt_at,latency_ms,item_count,last_error)
                         VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?) ON CONFLICT(source_name) DO UPDATE SET source_group=excluded.source_group,last_status=excluded.last_status,last_http_status=excluded.last_http_status,
                         last_success_at=CASE WHEN excluded.last_status='OK' THEN excluded.last_attempt_at ELSE context_source_status.last_success_at END,last_attempt_at=excluded.last_attempt_at,
                         latency_ms=excluded.latency_ms,item_count=excluded.item_count,last_error=excluded.last_error''',
                      (s["name"],s["group"],status,code,started if status=="OK" else None,started,lat,len(items),err))
        return result
    def collect(self,reason="schedule"):
        if not self.enabled: return {"status":"DISABLED"}
        if not self.run_lock.acquire(blocking=False): return {"status":"BUSY","run_id":self.last_run_id}
        try:
            started=now_kst(); run_id=started.strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S_CONTEXT")
            self.last_run_id=run_id
            with self._con() as c:
                c.execute("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO context_runs(run_id,status,started_at,source_count,error_json) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)",(run_id,"COLLECTING",started.isoformat(timespec="seconds"),len(self.sources),json.dumps({"reason":reason},ensure_ascii=False)))
            results=[]
            with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=max(1,self.max_workers)) as ex:
                fut=[ex.submit(self._fetch_source,s) for s in self.sources]
                for f in as_completed(fut): results.append(f.result())
            raw=[]; ok_by={"BROKER":0,"PORTAL":0,"MEDIA":0}; errors=[]
            for r in results:
                if r["status"]=="OK": ok_by[r["group"]]=ok_by.get(r["group"],0)+1
                elif r["status"]=="ERROR": errors.append({"source":r["name"],"error":r["error"]})
                for it in r["items"]:
                    raw.append({**it,"source_group":r["group"],"source_name":r["name"]})
            dedup={}
            for it in raw:
                h=_hash(it.get("title",""),it.get("url","")); it["item_hash"]=h; dedup[h]=it
            items=list(dedup.values())
            ok_sources=sum(1 for r in results if r["status"]=="OK")
            coverage=round(ok_sources/max(1,len(self.sources))*100,1)
            # Strict READY gate: at least one successful source in each required group and enough evidence.
            valid_groups=all(ok_by.get(g,0)>=1 for g in ("BROKER","PORTAL","MEDIA"))
            status="READY" if valid_groups and len(items)>=10 else ("PARTIAL" if items else "FAILED")
            content_hash=_hash(*sorted(i["item_hash"] for i in items)) if items else ""
            completed=now_iso()
            with self._con() as c:
                c.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
                c.execute("DELETE FROM context_items WHERE run_id=?",(run_id,))
                c.executemany('''INSERT OR IGNORE INTO context_items(run_id,source_group,source_name,published_at,title,url,summary,item_hash) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)''',
                    [(run_id,i["source_group"],i["source_name"],i.get("published_at"),i["title"],i.get("url"),i.get("summary"),i["item_hash"]) for i in items])
                c.execute('''UPDATE context_runs SET status=?,completed_at=?,ok_sources=?,broker_ok=?,portal_ok=?,media_ok=?,item_count=?,dedup_count=?,coverage_pct=?,content_sha256=?,error_json=? WHERE run_id=?''',
                    (status,completed,ok_sources,ok_by.get("BROKER",0),ok_by.get("PORTAL",0),ok_by.get("MEDIA",0),len(items),max(0,len(raw)-len(items)),coverage,content_hash,json.dumps(errors,ensure_ascii=False),run_id))
                # retention by completed runs
                old=c.execute("SELECT run_id FROM context_runs ORDER BY COALESCE(completed_at,started_at) DESC LIMIT -1 OFFSET ?",(self.retention_runs,)).fetchall()
                for row in old:
                    c.execute("DELETE FROM context_items WHERE run_id=?",(row[0],)); c.execute("DELETE FROM context_runs WHERE run_id=?",(row[0],))
                c.commit()
            LOG.info("CONTEXT_LEDGER_DONE run=%s status=%s items=%s coverage=%s broker=%s portal=%s media=%s",run_id,status,len(items),coverage,ok_by.get("BROKER",0),ok_by.get("PORTAL",0),ok_by.get("MEDIA",0))
            return self.manifest(run_id)
        except Exception as e:
            self.last_error=f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"; LOG.exception("CONTEXT_LEDGER_FAILED")
            return {"status":"FAILED","error":self.last_error}
        finally:
            self.run_lock.release()
    def manifest(self,run_id):
        with self._con() as c:
            r=c.execute("SELECT * FROM context_runs WHERE run_id=?",(run_id,)).fetchone()
        return dict(r) if r else None
    def latest(self,ready_only=True):
        with self._con() as c:
            q="SELECT * FROM context_runs WHERE status='READY' ORDER BY completed_at DESC LIMIT 1" if ready_only else "SELECT * FROM context_runs ORDER BY COALESCE(completed_at,started_at) DESC LIMIT 1"
            r=c.execute(q).fetchone()
        return dict(r) if r else None
    def latest_completed(self):
        with self._con() as c:
            r=c.execute("SELECT * FROM context_runs WHERE completed_at IS NOT NULL AND status IN ('READY','PARTIAL','FAILED') ORDER BY completed_at DESC LIMIT 1").fetchone()
        return dict(r) if r else None
    def items(self,run_id,group=None,limit=300):
        limit=max(1,min(int(limit),1000)); p=[run_id]; w="run_id=?"
        if group: w+=" AND source_group=?"; p.append(group.upper())
        p.append(limit)
        with self._con() as c:
            rows=c.execute(f"SELECT source_group,source_name,published_at,title,url,summary,item_hash FROM context_items WHERE {w} ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT ?",tuple(p)).fetchall()
        return [dict(x) for x in rows]
    def source_status(self):
        with self._con() as c: rows=c.execute("SELECT * FROM context_source_status ORDER BY source_group,source_name").fetchall()
        return [dict(x) for x in rows]
    def _market_manifest(self,market):
        payload=None; manifest=None; error=None
        try:
            _mh=self._headers()
            _mt=os.getenv("MARKET_LEDGER_TOKEN","").strip()
            if _mt: _mh["x-app-token"]=_mt
            r=requests.get(self.market_ledger_base+"/api/ledger/latest",params={"market":market},headers=_mh,timeout=min(8,self.timeout))
            if r.status_code==200:
                payload=r.json(); manifest=payload.get("manifest") if isinstance(payload,dict) else None
                if not isinstance(manifest,dict) and isinstance(payload,dict): manifest=payload
            else: error=f"HTTP {r.status_code}"
        except Exception as e:
            error=f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"
        return manifest,error
    def _ls_snapshot(self,market):
        state={}; result={}; errors=[]
        try:
            if callable(self.ls_status_provider): state=self.ls_status_provider() or {}
        except Exception as e: errors.append(f"status:{type(e).__name__}:{e}")
        try:
            if callable(self.ls_result_provider): result=self.ls_result_provider() or {}
        except Exception as e: errors.append(f"result:{type(e).__name__}:{e}")
        if not isinstance(state,dict): state={}
        if not isinstance(result,dict): result={}
        req=str(market or "KRX").upper()
        state_venue=str(state.get("venue") or state.get("expected_venue") or "").upper()
        result_venue=str(result.get("venue") or "").upper()
        market_match=(state_venue==req) or (result_venue==req)
        ws_status=str(state.get("ws_status") or "").upper()
        configured=bool(state.get("ls_configured"))
        result_status=str(result.get("status") or "").upper()
        result_ready=bool(result and result_venue==req and result_status in {"READY","OK","COMPLETE"})
        live_ready=bool(configured and state_venue==req and ws_status=="RECEIVING")
        usable=bool(market_match and (live_ready or result_ready or ws_status=="STALE"))
        ready=bool(live_ready or result_ready)
        mode="LIVE_WS" if live_ready else ("SNAPSHOT" if result_ready else ("STALE" if usable else "UNAVAILABLE"))
        return {
            "ready":ready,"usable":usable,"mode":mode,"configured":configured,"market_match":market_match,
            "requested_market":req,"state_venue":state_venue or None,"result_venue":result_venue or None,
            "ws_status":ws_status or None,"ws_tick_age_seconds":state.get("ws_tick_age_seconds"),
            "last_message_kst":state.get("ws_last_message_kst"),"result_timestamp_kst":result.get("timestamp_kst"),
            "errors":errors,
        }
    def _context_quality(self):
        ctx=self.latest_completed()
        if not ctx:
            return {"available":False,"full":False,"groups_available":0,"item_count":0,"status":"NONE","manifest":None,"groups":{"BROKER":False,"PORTAL":False,"MEDIA":False}}
        groups={"BROKER":int(ctx.get("broker_ok") or 0)>0,"PORTAL":int(ctx.get("portal_ok") or 0)>0,"MEDIA":int(ctx.get("media_ok") or 0)>0}
        n=sum(1 for v in groups.values() if v); items=int(ctx.get("item_count") or 0)
        return {"available":items>0,"full":all(groups.values()) and items>=10,"groups_available":n,"item_count":items,"status":ctx.get("status"),"manifest":ctx,"groups":groups}
    def work_gate(self, market="KRX"):
        market=str(market or "KRX").upper()
        m_manifest,m_error=self._market_manifest(market)
        market_ready=bool(isinstance(m_manifest,dict) and str(m_manifest.get("status") or "").upper()=="READY")
        ls=self._ls_snapshot(market)
        ctx=self._context_quality()
        if not market_ready:
            status="NOT_READY"; grade="STOP"; allowed=False
        elif ls.get("ready") and ctx.get("full"):
            status="FULL_READY"; grade="A+"; allowed=True
        elif ls.get("ready"):
            status="MARKET_READY"; grade="A"; allowed=True
        elif ls.get("usable") or ctx.get("available"):
            status="DEGRADED_READY"; grade="B"; allowed=True
        else:
            status="MARKET_ONLY"; grade="C"; allowed=True
        missing=[]
        if not ls.get("ready"): missing.append("LS_FULL_VALIDATION")
        for g,ok in (ctx.get("groups") or {}).items():
            if not ok: missing.append(g)
        return {
            "status":status,"work_allowed":allowed,"data_grade":grade,"market":market,
            "market_ready":market_ready,"market_manifest":m_manifest,"market_error":m_error,
            "ls":ls,"context":ctx,"missing_axes":missing,
            "context_is_blocking":False,
            "policy":"KIS_MARKET_LEDGER_AUTHORITY__LS_INDEPENDENT_CROSSCHECK__BROKER_PORTAL_MEDIA_OPTIONAL_EVIDENCE",
            "read_order":["KIS_MARKET_LEDGER","LS_RADAR","BROKER","PORTAL","MEDIA"],
            "now_kst":now_iso()
        }
    def health(self):
        latest=self.latest(False); ready=self.latest(True)
        return {"ok":True,"service":"KR_MARKET_CONTEXT_LEDGER_V1_1","enabled":self.enabled,"storage":"LOCAL_SQLITE_RECOLLECTABLE","db_path":str(self.db_path),"latest":latest,"latest_ready":ready,"last_error":self.last_error,"source_count":len(self.sources),"interval_seconds":self.interval,"authority":"CONTEXT_OPTIONAL_NEVER_OVERRIDES_KIS_MARKET_LEDGER"}
    def _loop(self):
        time.sleep(_int("CONTEXT_LEDGER_START_DELAY_SECONDS",8))
        while True:
            self.collect("startup_or_interval")
            time.sleep(max(60,self.interval))
    def start(self):
        if self.enabled:
            threading.Thread(target=self._loop,daemon=True,name="context-ledger").start()
            LOG.info("CONTEXT_LEDGER_STARTED interval=%ss sources=%s",self.interval,len(self.sources))
    def handle_get(self,raw_path):
        u=urlparse(raw_path); path=u.path; qs=parse_qs(u.query)
        if path=="/api/context/health": return 200,self.health()
        if path=="/api/context/latest":
            m=self.latest_completed()
            if not m:return 404,{"status":"NO_COMPLETED_CONTEXT_LEDGER"}
            return 200,{"manifest":m,"items":self.items(m["run_id"],None,_int("CONTEXT_LEDGER_API_ITEM_LIMIT",300)),"blocking":False}
        if path=="/api/context/latest/manifest":
            m=self.latest_completed(); return (200,m) if m else (404,{"status":"NO_COMPLETED_CONTEXT_LEDGER"})
        if path=="/api/context/latest/items":
            m=self.latest_completed()
            if not m:return 404,{"status":"NO_COMPLETED_CONTEXT_LEDGER"}
            return 200,{"run_id":m["run_id"],"items":self.items(m["run_id"],(qs.get("group")or[None])[0],(qs.get("limit")or[300])[0]),"blocking":False}
        if path=="/api/context/source-status": return 200,{"sources":self.source_status(),"now_kst":now_iso()}
        if path=="/api/context/ls-bridge": return 200,self._ls_snapshot((qs.get("market")or["KRX"])[0])
        if path=="/api/context/work-gate": return 200,self.work_gate((qs.get("market")or["KRX"])[0])
        m=re.match(r"^/api/context/run/([^/]+)/manifest$",path)
        if m:
            z=self.manifest(m.group(1)); return (200,z) if z else (404,{"error":"run not found"})
        m=re.match(r"^/api/context/run/([^/]+)/items$",path)
        if m:
            z=self.manifest(m.group(1))
            if not z:return 404,{"error":"run not found"}
            return 200,{"run_id":m.group(1),"items":self.items(m.group(1),(qs.get("group")or[None])[0],(qs.get("limit")or[300])[0])}
        return None
    def handle_post(self,raw_path,headers):
        path=urlparse(raw_path).path
        if path!="/api/context/collect":return None
        token=os.getenv("CONTEXT_ADMIN_TOKEN","").strip()
        if not token or headers.get("X-Admin-Token","")!=token:return 403,{"error":"manual collection disabled or unauthorized"}
        threading.Thread(target=self.collect,args=("manual",),daemon=True).start(); return 202,{"accepted":True}

def _bool(name, default=False):

    def _sources(self):

    def _con(self):

    def _init_db(self):
        with self._con() as c:
            c.executescript('''
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS context_runs(
              run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,status TEXT NOT NULL,started_at TEXT,completed_at TEXT,
              source_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,ok_sources INTEGER DEFAULT 0,broker_ok INTEGER DEFAULT 0,portal_ok INTEGER DEFAULT 0,media_ok INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
              item_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,dedup_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,coverage_pct REAL DEFAULT 0,content_sha256 TEXT,error_json TEXT

    def _headers(self):
        return {"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; KRMarketContextLedger/1.2; +Render)","Accept":"application/rss+xml,application/xml,text/xml,text/html,application/json;q=0.9,*/*;q=0.8"}
    def _request(self,url):
        err=None
        for i in range(max(1,self.retries)):
            t=time.monotonic()
            try:
                r=requests.get(url,headers=self._headers(),timeout=self.timeout,allow_redirects=True)
                lat=int((time.monotonic()-t)*1000)
                if r.status_code>=500 or r.status_code==429:
                    err=RuntimeError(f"HTTP {r.status_code}"); time.sleep(min(4,0.5*(2**i))); continue
                r.raise_for_status(); return r,lat
            except Exception as e:
                err=e; time.sleep(min(4,0.5*(2**i)))
        raise err or RuntimeError("request failed")
    def _parse_rss(self,text):
        out=[]
        root=ET.fromstring(text)
        for node in root.findall(".//item")[:self.max_items_source]:
            title=_clean_text(node.findtext("title")); link=(node.findtext("link") or "").strip(); pub=_clean_text(node.findtext("pubDate")); desc=_clean_text(node.findtext("description"))
            if title: out.append({"title":title,"url":link,"published_at":pub,"summary":desc[:280]})
        return out
    def _parse_html(self,text):
        out=[]; seen=set()
        for m in re.finditer(r'<a[^>]+href=["\']([^"\']+)["\'][^>]*>(.*?)</a>',text,re.I|re.S):
            href=m.group(1); title=_clean_text(m.group(2))
            if len(title)<8 or title in seen: continue
            if href.startswith("/"): href="https://stock.naver.com"+href
            if not href.startswith("http"): continue
            seen.add(title); out.append({"title":title,"url":href,"published_at":"","summary":""})
            if len(out)>=self.max_items_source: break
        return out
    def _fetch_source(self,s):
        started=now_iso(); t=time.monotonic(); status="ERROR"; code=None; items=[]; err=""
        try:
            r,lat=self._request(s["url"]); code=r.status_code
            if s.get("kind")=="html": items=self._parse_html(r.text)
            else: items=self._parse_rss(r.text)
            status="OK" if items else "EMPTY"
        except Exception as e:
            lat=int((time.monotonic()-t)*1000); err=f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"
        result={**s,"status":status,"http_status":code,"latency_ms":lat,"items":items,"error":err,"attempt_at":started}
        with self._con() as c:
            c.execute('''INSERT INTO context_source_status(source_name,source_group,last_status,last_http_status,last_success_at,last_attempt_at,latency_ms,item_count,last_error)
                         VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?) ON CONFLICT(source_name) DO UPDATE SET source_group=excluded.source_group,last_status=excluded.last_status,last_http_status=excluded.last_http_status,
                         last_success_at=CASE WHEN excluded.last_status='OK' THEN excluded.last_attempt_at ELSE context_source_status.last_success_at END,last_attempt_at=excluded.last_attempt_at,
                         latency_ms=excluded.latency_ms,item_count=excluded.item_count,last_error=excluded.last_error''',
                      (s["name"],s["group"],status,code,started if status=="OK" else None,started,lat,len(items),err))
        return result
    def collect(self,reason="schedule"):
        if not self.enabled: return {"status":"DISABLED"}
        if not self.run_lock.acquire(blocking=False): return {"status":"BUSY","run_id":self.last_run_id}
        try:
            started=now_kst(); run_id=started.strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S_CONTEXT")
            self.last_run_id=run_id
            with self._con() as c:
                c.execute("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO context_runs(run_id,status,started_at,source_count,error_json) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)",(run_id,"COLLECTING",started.isoformat(timespec="seconds"),len(self.sources),json.dumps({"reason":reason},ensure_ascii=False)))
            results=[]
            with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=max(1,self.max_workers)) as ex:
                fut=[ex.submit(self._fetch_source,s) for s in self.sources]
                for f in as_completed(fut): results.append(f.result())
            raw=[]; ok_by={"BROKER":0,"PORTAL":0,"MEDIA":0}; errors=[]
            for r in results:
                if r["status"]=="OK": ok_by[r["group"]]=ok_by.get(r["group"],0)+1
                elif r["status"]=="ERROR": errors.append({"source":r["name"],"error":r["error"]})
                for it in r["items"]:
                    raw.append({**it,"source_group":r["group"],"source_name":r["name"]})
            dedup={}
            for it in raw:
                h=_hash(it.get("title",""),it.get("url","")); it["item_hash"]=h; dedup[h]=it
            items=list(dedup.values())
            ok_sources=sum(1 for r in results if r["status"]=="OK")
            coverage=round(ok_sources/max(1,len(self.sources))*100,1)
            # Strict READY gate: at least one successful source in each required group and enough evidence.
            valid_groups=all(ok_by.get(g,0)>=1 for g in ("BROKER","PORTAL","MEDIA"))
            status="READY" if valid_groups and len(items)>=10 else ("PARTIAL" if items else "FAILED")
            content_hash=_hash(*sorted(i["item_hash"] for i in items)) if items else ""
            completed=now_iso()
            with self._con() as c:
                c.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
                c.execute("DELETE FROM context_items WHERE run_id=?",(run_id,))
                c.executemany('''INSERT OR IGNORE INTO context_items(run_id,source_group,source_name,published_at,title,url,summary,item_hash) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)''',
                    [(run_id,i["source_group"],i["source_name"],i.get("published_at"),i["title"],i.get("url"),i.get("summary"),i["item_hash"]) for i in items])
                c.execute('''UPDATE context_runs SET status=?,completed_at=?,ok_sources=?,broker_ok=?,portal_ok=?,media_ok=?,item_count=?,dedup_count=?,coverage_pct=?,content_sha256=?,error_json=? WHERE run_id=?''',
                    (status,completed,ok_sources,ok_by.get("BROKER",0),ok_by.get("PORTAL",0),ok_by.get("MEDIA",0),len(items),max(0,len(raw)-len(items)),coverage,content_hash,json.dumps(errors,ensure_ascii=False),run_id))
                # retention by completed runs
                old=c.execute("SELECT run_id FROM context_runs ORDER BY COALESCE(completed_at,started_at) DESC LIMIT -1 OFFSET ?",(self.retention_runs,)).fetchall()
                for row in old:
                    c.execute("DELETE FROM context_items WHERE run_id=?",(row[0],)); c.execute("DELETE FROM context_runs WHERE run_id=?",(row[0],))
                c.commit()
            LOG.info("CONTEXT_LEDGER_DONE run=%s status=%s items=%s coverage=%s broker=%s portal=%s media=%s",run_id,status,len(items),coverage,ok_by.get("BROKER",0),ok_by.get("PORTAL",0),ok_by.get("MEDIA",0))
            return self.manifest(run_id)
        except Exception as e:
            self.last_error=f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"; LOG.exception("CONTEXT_LEDGER_FAILED")
            return {"status":"FAILED","error":self.last_error}
        finally:
            self.run_lock.release()
    def manifest(self,run_id):
        with self._con() as c:
            r=c.execute("SELECT * FROM context_runs WHERE run_id=?",(run_id,)).fetchone()
        return dict(r) if r else None
    def latest(self,ready_only=True):
        with self._con() as c:
            q="SELECT * FROM context_runs WHERE status='READY' ORDER BY completed_at DESC LIMIT 1" if ready_only else "SELECT * FROM context_runs ORDER BY COALESCE(completed_at,started_at) DESC LIMIT 1"
            r=c.execute(q).fetchone()
        return dict(r) if r else None
    def latest_completed(self):
        with self._con() as c:
            r=c.execute("SELECT * FROM context_runs WHERE completed_at IS NOT NULL AND status IN ('READY','PARTIAL','FAILED') ORDER BY completed_at DESC LIMIT 1").fetchone()
        return dict(r) if r else None
    def items(self,run_id,group=None,limit=300):
        limit=max(1,min(int(limit),1000)); p=[run_id]; w="run_id=?"
        if group: w+=" AND source_group=?"; p.append(group.upper())
        p.append(limit)
        with self._con() as c:
            rows=c.execute(f"SELECT source_group,source_name,published_at,title,url,summary,item_hash FROM context_items WHERE {w} ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT ?",tuple(p)).fetchall()
        return [dict(x) for x in rows]
    def source_status(self):
        with self._con() as c: rows=c.execute("SELECT * FROM context_source_status ORDER BY source_group,source_name").fetchall()
        return [dict(x) for x in rows]
    def _market_manifest(self,market):
        payload=None; manifest=None; error=None
        try:
            _mh=self._headers()
            _mt=os.getenv("MARKET_LEDGER_TOKEN","").strip()
            if _mt: _mh["x-app-token"]=_mt
            r=requests.get(self.market_ledger_base+"/api/ledger/latest",params={"market":market},headers=_mh,timeout=min(8,self.timeout))
            if r.status_code==200:
                payload=r.json(); manifest=payload.get("manifest") if isinstance(payload,dict) else None
                if not isinstance(manifest,dict) and isinstance(payload,dict): manifest=payload
            else: error=f"HTTP {r.status_code}"
        except Exception as e:
            error=f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"
        return manifest,error
    def _ls_snapshot(self,market):
        state={}; result={}; errors=[]
        try:
            if callable(self.ls_status_provider): state=self.ls_status_provider() or {}
        except Exception as e: errors.append(f"status:{type(e).__name__}:{e}")
        try:
            if callable(self.ls_result_provider): result=self.ls_result_provider() or {}
        except Exception as e: errors.append(f"result:{type(e).__name__}:{e}")
        if not isinstance(state,dict): state={}
        if not isinstance(result,dict): result={}
        req=str(market or "KRX").upper()
        state_venue=str(state.get("venue") or state.get("expected_venue") or "").upper()
        result_venue=str(result.get("venue") or "").upper()
        market_match=(state_venue==req) or (result_venue==req)
        ws_status=str(state.get("ws_status") or "").upper()
        configured=bool(state.get("ls_configured"))
        result_status=str(result.get("status") or "").upper()
        result_ready=bool(result and result_venue==req and result_status in {"READY","OK","COMPLETE"})
        live_ready=bool(configured and state_venue==req and ws_status=="RECEIVING")
        usable=bool(market_match and (live_ready or result_ready or ws_status=="STALE"))
        ready=bool(live_ready or result_ready)
        mode="LIVE_WS" if live_ready else ("SNAPSHOT" if result_ready else ("STALE" if usable else "UNAVAILABLE"))
        return {
            "ready":ready,"usable":usable,"mode":mode,"configured":configured,"market_match":market_match,
            "requested_market":req,"state_venue":state_venue or None,"result_venue":result_venue or None,
            "ws_status":ws_status or None,"ws_tick_age_seconds":state.get("ws_tick_age_seconds"),
            "last_message_kst":state.get("ws_last_message_kst"),"result_timestamp_kst":result.get("timestamp_kst"),
            "errors":errors,
        }
    def _ls_result_for_market(self, market):
        req=str(market or "KRX").upper()
        result={}
        try:
            if callable(self.ls_result_for_venue_provider): result=self.ls_result_for_venue_provider(req) or {}
            elif callable(self.ls_result_provider): result=self.ls_result_provider() or {}
        except Exception as e:
            return {}, f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"
        if not isinstance(result,dict): return {}, "LS_RESULT_NOT_DICT"
        venue=str(result.get("venue") or "").upper()
        if venue and venue!=req: return {}, f"VENUE_MISMATCH:{venue}"
        return result, None
    def _ls_quotes(self, market="KRX", limit=500):
        req=str(market or "KRX").upper(); limit=max(1,min(int(limit),1000))
        result,error=self._ls_result_for_market(req)
        if not result:
            return {"market":req,"status":"UNAVAILABLE","error":error,"timestamp_kst":None,"total":0,"rows":[]}
        stamp=result.get("timestamp_kst") or result.get("updated_at") or result.get("generated_at")
        pools=[]
        for key in ("live_pool","live_deep30","live_watch10","top_final","top_watch","anchor_sensors","sector_live_pool"):
            value=result.get(key)
            if isinstance(value,list): pools.extend(value)
        out={}
        def fnum(v):
            try: return float(str(v).replace(",","").replace("%","").strip())
            except Exception: return None
        for r in pools:
            if not isinstance(r,dict): continue
            code=str(r.get("symbol") or r.get("code") or r.get("stock_code") or "").strip().zfill(6)
            if len(code)!=6: continue
            price=None
            for k in ("current_price","price","stage1_close","last_price","close"):
                price=fnum(r.get(k))
                if price not in (None,0.0): break
            if price in (None,0.0): continue
            chg=None
            for k in ("change_pct","current_return_pct","change_rate","return_pct"):
                chg=fnum(r.get(k))
                if chg is not None: break
            prev=out.get(code)
            row={"code":code,"name":str(r.get("name") or r.get("stock_name") or code),"price":price,"change_pct":chg,
                 "timestamp_kst":stamp,"venue":req,"source":"LS_ALPHA500_READONLY"}
            if prev is None: out[code]=row
        rows=list(out.values())[:limit]
        return {"market":req,"status":"READY" if rows else "EMPTY","error":error,"timestamp_kst":stamp,"total":len(out),"rows":rows}
    def _market_rows(self,market,limit=5000):
        headers=self._headers(); token=os.getenv("MARKET_LEDGER_TOKEN","").strip()
        if token: headers["x-app-token"]=token
        r=requests.get(self.market_ledger_base+"/api/ledger/latest/rows",params={"market":market,"limit":max(1,min(int(limit),5000))},headers=headers,timeout=min(12,self.timeout))
        if r.status_code!=200: return [],None,f"HTTP {r.status_code}"
        p=r.json() if r.content else {}; return (p.get("rows") or []),(p.get("manifest") or {}),None
    def _parse_dt(self,value,assume_kst=False):
        if value in (None,""): return None
        try:
            s=str(value).replace("Z","+00:00"); d=datetime.fromisoformat(s)
            if d.tzinfo is None: d=d.replace(tzinfo=KST if assume_kst else timezone.utc)
            return d.astimezone(timezone.utc)
        except Exception:return None
    def cross_check(self,market="KRX",limit=500):
        req=str(market or "KRX").upper(); now=time.monotonic(); ttl=max(5,_int("CONTEXT_CROSSCHECK_CACHE_SECONDS",30)); key=(req,int(limit))
        cached=self.cross_cache.get(key)
        if cached and now-cached[0] <= ttl:return cached[1]
        ls=self._ls_quotes(req,limit); kis_rows,kis_manifest,kerr=self._market_rows(req,5000)
        kis={str(r.get("code") or "").zfill(6):r for r in kis_rows if isinstance(r,dict)}
        max_skew=max(10,_int("CONTEXT_CROSSCHECK_MAX_TIME_SKEW_SECONDS",120))
        match_tol=float(os.getenv("CONTEXT_CROSSCHECK_MATCH_PCT","0.15")); near_tol=float(os.getenv("CONTEXT_CROSSCHECK_NEAR_PCT","0.50"))
        details=[]; counts={"MATCH":0,"NEAR":0,"PRICE_DIVERGENCE":0,"TIME_SKEW":0,"TIME_UNKNOWN":0,"KIS_TIME_UNVERIFIED":0,"NO_KIS":0}
        ls_dt=self._parse_dt(ls.get("timestamp_kst"),True)
        for x in ls.get("rows") or []:
            k=kis.get(x["code"])
            if not k:
                counts["NO_KIS"]+=1; details.append({**x,"state":"NO_KIS"}); continue
            kp=float(k.get("price") or 0); lp=float(x.get("price") or 0); diff=abs(lp-kp)/kp*100 if kp>0 else None
            q=str(k.get("source_timestamp_quality") or "LEGACY_UNKNOWN").upper(); kd=self._parse_dt(k.get("source_timestamp"),False)
            skew=abs((ls_dt-kd).total_seconds()) if (ls_dt and kd) else None
            if q=="REQUEST_TIME_ONLY": state="KIS_TIME_UNVERIFIED"
            elif skew is None: state="TIME_UNKNOWN"
            elif skew>max_skew: state="TIME_SKEW"
            elif diff is not None and diff<=match_tol: state="MATCH"
            elif diff is not None and diff<=near_tol: state="NEAR"
            else: state="PRICE_DIVERGENCE"
            counts[state]=counts.get(state,0)+1
            details.append({"code":x["code"],"name":x.get("name"),"kis_price":kp,"ls_price":lp,"price_diff_pct":round(diff,4) if diff is not None else None,
                            "time_skew_seconds":round(skew,1) if skew is not None else None,"kis_timestamp_quality":q,"state":state})
        comparable=counts["MATCH"]+counts["NEAR"]+counts["PRICE_DIVERGENCE"]
        out={"market":req,"status":"OK" if not kerr else "DEGRADED","kis_error":kerr,"kis_round_id":(kis_manifest or {}).get("round_id"),
             "ls_timestamp_kst":ls.get("timestamp_kst"),"ls_quotes":len(ls.get("rows") or []),"overlap":len(details),"comparable":comparable,"counts":counts,
             "match_rate_pct":round((counts["MATCH"]+counts["NEAR"])/comparable*100,2) if comparable else None,
             "policy":"READ_ONLY; compare only when timestamps are sufficiently aligned; never overwrite KIS authority","rows":details[:max(1,min(int(limit),500))]}
        self.cross_cache[key]=(now,out); return out

    def _context_quality(self):
        ctx=self.latest_completed()
        if not ctx:
            return {"available":False,"full":False,"groups_available":0,"item_count":0,"status":"NONE","manifest":None,"groups":{"BROKER":False,"PORTAL":False,"MEDIA":False}}
        groups={"BROKER":int(ctx.get("broker_ok") or 0)>0,"PORTAL":int(ctx.get("portal_ok") or 0)>0,"MEDIA":int(ctx.get("media_ok") or 0)>0}
        n=sum(1 for v in groups.values() if v); items=int(ctx.get("item_count") or 0)
        return {"available":items>0,"full":all(groups.values()) and items>=10,"groups_available":n,"item_count":items,"status":ctx.get("status"),"manifest":ctx,"groups":groups}
    def work_gate(self, market="KRX"):
        market=str(market or "KRX").upper()
        m_manifest,m_error=self._market_manifest(market)
        market_ready=bool(isinstance(m_manifest,dict) and str(m_manifest.get("status") or "").upper()=="READY")
        ls=self._ls_snapshot(market)
        cross=self.cross_check(market,_int("CONTEXT_CROSSCHECK_LIMIT",200))
        ctx=self._context_quality()
        if not market_ready:
            status="NOT_READY"; grade="STOP"; allowed=False
        elif ls.get("ready") and ctx.get("full"):
            status="FULL_READY"; grade="A+"; allowed=True
        elif ls.get("ready"):
            status="MARKET_READY"; grade="A"; allowed=True
        elif ls.get("usable") or ctx.get("available"):
            status="DEGRADED_READY"; grade="B"; allowed=True
        else:
            status="MARKET_ONLY"; grade="C"; allowed=True
        missing=[]
        if not ls.get("ready"): missing.append("LS_FULL_VALIDATION")
        for g,ok in (ctx.get("groups") or {}).items():
            if not ok: missing.append(g)
        return {
            "status":status,"work_allowed":allowed,"data_grade":grade,"market":market,
            "market_ready":market_ready,"market_manifest":m_manifest,"market_error":m_error,
            "ls":ls,"cross_validation":cross,"context":ctx,"missing_axes":missing,
            "context_is_blocking":False,
            "policy":"KIS_MARKET_LEDGER_AUTHORITY__LS_INDEPENDENT_CROSSCHECK__BROKER_PORTAL_MEDIA_OPTIONAL_EVIDENCE",
            "read_order":["KIS_MARKET_LEDGER","LS_RADAR","BROKER","PORTAL","MEDIA"],
            "now_kst":now_iso()
        }
    def health(self):
        latest=self.latest(False); ready=self.latest(True)
        return {"ok":True,"service":"KR_MARKET_CONTEXT_LEDGER_V1_2","enabled":self.enabled,"storage":"LOCAL_SQLITE_RECOLLECTABLE","db_path":str(self.db_path),"latest":latest,"latest_ready":ready,"last_error":self.last_error,"source_count":len(self.sources),"interval_seconds":self.interval,"authority":"CONTEXT_OPTIONAL_NEVER_OVERRIDES_KIS_MARKET_LEDGER"}
    def _loop(self):
        time.sleep(_int("CONTEXT_LEDGER_START_DELAY_SECONDS",8))
        while True:
            self.collect("startup_or_interval")
            time.sleep(max(60,self.interval))
    def start(self):
        if self.enabled:
            threading.Thread(target=self._loop,daemon=True,name="context-ledger").start()
            LOG.info("CONTEXT_LEDGER_STARTED interval=%ss sources=%s",self.interval,len(self.sources))
    def handle_get(self,raw_path):
        u=urlparse(raw_path); path=u.path; qs=parse_qs(u.query)
        if path=="/api/context/health": return 200,self.health()
        if path=="/api/context/latest":
            m=self.latest_completed()
            if not m:return 404,{"status":"NO_COMPLETED_CONTEXT_LEDGER"}
            return 200,{"manifest":m,"items":self.items(m["run_id"],None,_int("CONTEXT_LEDGER_API_ITEM_LIMIT",300)),"blocking":False}
        if path=="/api/context/latest/manifest":
            m=self.latest_completed(); return (200,m) if m else (404,{"status":"NO_COMPLETED_CONTEXT_LEDGER"})
        if path=="/api/context/latest/items":
            m=self.latest_completed()
            if not m:return 404,{"status":"NO_COMPLETED_CONTEXT_LEDGER"}
            return 200,{"run_id":m["run_id"],"items":self.items(m["run_id"],(qs.get("group")or[None])[0],(qs.get("limit")or[300])[0]),"blocking":False}
        if path=="/api/context/source-status": return 200,{"sources":self.source_status(),"now_kst":now_iso()}
        if path=="/api/context/ls-bridge": return 200,self._ls_snapshot((qs.get("market")or["KRX"])[0])
        if path=="/api/context/ls-quotes": return 200,self._ls_quotes((qs.get("market")or["KRX"])[0],int((qs.get("limit")or["500"])[0]))
        if path=="/api/context/cross-check": return 200,self.cross_check((qs.get("market")or["KRX"])[0],int((qs.get("limit")or["200"])[0]))
        if path=="/api/context/work-gate": return 200,self.work_gate((qs.get("market")or["KRX"])[0])
        m=re.match(r"^/api/context/run/([^/]+)/manifest$",path)
        if m:
            z=self.manifest(m.group(1)); return (200,z) if z else (404,{"error":"run not found"})
        m=re.match(r"^/api/context/run/([^/]+)/items$",path)
        if m:
            z=self.manifest(m.group(1))
            if not z:return 404,{"error":"run not found"}
            return 200,{"run_id":m.group(1),"items":self.items(m.group(1),(qs.get("group")or[None])[0],(qs.get("limit")or[300])[0])}
        return None
    def handle_post(self,raw_path,headers):
        path=urlparse(raw_path).path
        if path!="/api/context/collect":return None
        token=os.getenv("CONTEXT_ADMIN_TOKEN","").strip()
        if not token or headers.get("X-Admin-Token","")!=token:return 403,{"error":"manual collection disabled or unauthorized"}
        threading.Thread(target=self.collect,args=("manual",),daemon=True).start(); return 202,{"accepted":True}

s=s.replace('''"read_order":["KIS_MARKET_LEDGER","LS_RADAR","BROKER","PORTAL","MEDIA"]''',
'''"read_order":["KIS_LIVE_LEDGER","KIS_IMMUTABLE_SNAPSHOT","LS_RADAR","BROKER","PORTAL","MEDIA"]''',1)
s=s.replace('''"service":"KR_MARKET_CONTEXT_LEDGER_V1_2"''','''"service":"KR_MARKET_CONTEXT_LEDGER_V1_3_LIVE_BRIDGE"''',1)
p.write_text(s,encoding='utf-8')

# ===== LS PROGRAM TREND LEDGER V1.4 · t1632/t1636/t1637 =====
# 기존 LS WS/가격/에너지/판정 로직은 변경하지 않고 독립 보조원장만 추가한다.
COPY <<'LS_PROGRAM_TREND_V14_MODULE' /app/ls_program_trend_sidecar.py
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
from __future__ import annotations
import json, logging, math, os, re, sqlite3, threading, time
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import parse_qs, urlparse

KST = timezone(timedelta(hours=9))
LOG = logging.getLogger('ls_program_trend')

def _bool(name, default=False):
    return os.getenv(name, 'true' if default else 'false').strip().lower() in {'1','true','yes','y','on'}
def _int(name, default):
    try: return int(os.getenv(name, str(default)))
    except Exception: return default
def _num(v, default=None):
    try:
        if v in (None, '', ' '): return default
        x = float(str(v).replace(',', ''))
        return x if math.isfinite(x) else default
    except Exception: return default
def _now(): return datetime.now(KST)
def _iso(): return _now().isoformat(timespec='seconds')
def _code(v):
    s = str(v or '').strip()
    return s.zfill(6) if re.fullmatch(r'\d{1,6}', s) else ''
def _hms(v):
    s = re.sub(r'\D', '', str(v or ''))
    if len(s) >= 6: s = s[-6:]
    elif len(s) == 4: s += '00'
    else: return None
    try: return int(s[:2])*3600 + int(s[2:4])*60 + int(s[4:6])
    except Exception: return None

class LSProgramTrendLedger:
    VERSION = 'LS_PROGRAM_TREND_V1_5_SESSION_GUARD_RATE_LIMIT'
    def __init__(self):
        self.enabled = _bool('LS_PROGRAM_LEDGER_ENABLED', True)
        self.interval = max(60, _int('LS_PROGRAM_LEDGER_INTERVAL_SECONDS', 600))
        self.stock_limit = max(1, min(60, _int('LS_PROGRAM_STOCK_LIMIT_PER_MARKET', 18)))
        self.retention_runs = max(12, _int('LS_PROGRAM_RETENTION_RUNS', 144))
        self.start_delay = max(0, _int('LS_PROGRAM_START_DELAY_SECONDS', 20))
        # V1.5: 장전/장후 불필요한 프로그램 TR 호출을 차단하고, 0행을 장애로 오판하지 않는다.
        self.session_guard = _bool('LS_PROGRAM_SESSION_GUARD_ENABLED', True)
        self.krx_start = os.getenv('LS_PROGRAM_KRX_START_HHMM', '0900')
        self.krx_end = os.getenv('LS_PROGRAM_KRX_END_HHMM', '1540')
        self.nxt_start = os.getenv('LS_PROGRAM_NXT_START_HHMM', '0800')
        self.nxt_end = os.getenv('LS_PROGRAM_NXT_END_HHMM', '2005')
        self.empty_grace_minutes = max(0, _int('LS_PROGRAM_EMPTY_GRACE_MINUTES', 15))
        self.rate_limit_cooldown_seconds = max(60, _int('LS_PROGRAM_RATE_LIMIT_COOLDOWN_SECONDS', 600))
        self._rate_limit_until = 0.0
        self.runtime_state = {
            'KRX': {'status':'INIT','reason':'STARTUP'},
            'NXT': {'status':'INIT','reason':'STARTUP'},
        }
        self.db_path = Path(os.getenv('LS_PROGRAM_DB_PATH', '/data/context_ledger/ls_program_trend.db'))
        self.db_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self.ls_provider = None
        self.candidate_provider = None
        self.run_lock = threading.Lock()
        self.last_error = None
        self._init_db()

    def bind(self, ls_provider=None, candidate_provider=None):
        self.ls_provider = ls_provider
        self.candidate_provider = candidate_provider
        LOG.info('LS_PROGRAM_LEDGER_BOUND ls=%s candidates=%s', bool(ls_provider), bool(candidate_provider))

    def _ls(self):
        p = self.ls_provider() if callable(self.ls_provider) else self.ls_provider
        if p is None: raise RuntimeError('LS_PROVIDER_UNBOUND')
        return p

    def _con(self):
        c = sqlite3.connect(str(self.db_path), timeout=30, check_same_thread=False)
        c.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        c.execute('PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL')
        c.execute('PRAGMA synchronous=NORMAL')
        return c

    def _init_db(self):
        with self._con() as c:
            c.executescript('''
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ls_program_runs(
              run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, market TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL,
              started_at TEXT, completed_at TEXT, candidate_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
              stock_success INTEGER DEFAULT 0, market_rows INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
              ranking_rows INTEGER DEFAULT 0, error_json TEXT);
            CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_lspr_runs ON ls_program_runs(market,status,completed_at DESC);
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ls_program_market(
              id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, run_id TEXT NOT NULL, market TEXT NOT NULL,
              segment TEXT, unit TEXT, date TEXT, time TEXT,
              total_net REAL,total_buy REAL,total_sell REAL,
              arb_net REAL,arb_buy REAL,arb_sell REAL,
              nonarb_net REAL,nonarb_buy REAL,nonarb_sell REAL, raw_json TEXT);
            CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_lspr_market ON ls_program_market(market,run_id,time);
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ls_program_ranking(
              id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, run_id TEXT NOT NULL, market TEXT NOT NULL,
              segment TEXT, rank_no INTEGER, code TEXT, name TEXT,
              price REAL, change_pct REAL, net_qty REAL,buy_qty REAL,sell_qty REAL,
              net_amt REAL,buy_amt REAL,sell_amt REAL, raw_json TEXT);
            CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_lspr_rank ON ls_program_ranking(market,run_id,rank_no);
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ls_program_stock(
              id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, run_id TEXT NOT NULL, market TEXT NOT NULL,
              code TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT, date TEXT, time TEXT, price REAL, change_pct REAL,
              volume REAL, net_qty REAL,buy_qty REAL,sell_qty REAL,
              net_amt REAL,buy_amt REAL,sell_amt REAL, raw_json TEXT);
            CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_lspr_stock ON ls_program_stock(market,code,run_id,time);
            ''')
            c.commit()

    def _post(self, tr_cd, body):
        return self._ls()._post_tr('/stock/program', tr_cd, body).json()

    def _segments(self):
        raw = os.getenv('LS_PROGRAM_MARKET_GUBUNS', '0:KOSPI,1:KOSDAQ')
        out = []
        for x in raw.split(','):
            if ':' in x:
                g,n = x.split(':',1)
                if g.strip() and n.strip(): out.append((g.strip(), n.strip().upper()))
        return out or [('0','KOSPI'),('1','KOSDAQ')]

    def _summary(self, market):
        try:
            x = self.candidate_provider(market) if callable(self.candidate_provider) else {}
            return x if isinstance(x, dict) else {}
        except Exception as e:
            LOG.warning('candidate provider failed market=%s err=%s', market, e)
            return {}

    def _hm_min(self, value, default):
        s = re.sub(r'\D', '', str(value or default))
        if len(s) != 4: s = default
        try:
            h, m = int(s[:2]), int(s[2:])
            if 0 <= h <= 23 and 0 <= m <= 59: return h*60 + m
        except Exception:
            pass
        d = re.sub(r'\D', '', str(default))
        return int(d[:2])*60 + int(d[2:])

    def _rate_limited(self, err):
        t = str(err or '')
        return ('IGW00201' in t or '호출 거래건수를 초과' in t or 'RATE_LIMIT' in t.upper() or 'HTTP 429' in t.upper())

    def _session_hint(self, market):
        s = self._summary(market)
        text = ' '.join(str(s.get(k) or '') for k in ('session','status','market_status','phase','reason')).upper()
        if any(x in text for x in ('NON_TRADING_DAY','HOLIDAY','MARKET_HOLIDAY')):
            return 'NON_TRADING_DAY'
        return None

    def _session_state(self, market):
        now = _now()
        # API 유량제한이 한 번 확인되면 KRX/NXT 공통으로 쿨다운하여 retry storm을 막는다.
        remain = int(max(0, self._rate_limit_until - time.monotonic()))
        if remain > 0:
            return {'allowed':False,'status':'PENDING','reason':'RATE_LIMIT_COOLDOWN','retry_after_seconds':remain,'now_kst':_iso()}
        if not self.session_guard:
            return {'allowed':True,'status':'ACTIVE','reason':'SESSION_GUARD_DISABLED','now_kst':_iso()}
        hint = self._session_hint(market)
        if hint:
            return {'allowed':False,'status':'PENDING','reason':hint,'now_kst':_iso()}
        if now.weekday() >= 5:
            return {'allowed':False,'status':'PENDING','reason':'NON_TRADING_DAY','now_kst':_iso()}
        start_s, end_s = ((self.nxt_start,self.nxt_end) if market == 'NXT' else (self.krx_start,self.krx_end))
        start = self._hm_min(start_s, '0800' if market == 'NXT' else '0900')
        end = self._hm_min(end_s, '2005' if market == 'NXT' else '1540')
        cur = now.hour*60 + now.minute
        if cur < start:
            return {'allowed':False,'status':'PENDING','reason':'WAITING_SESSION','session_start_hhmm':f'{start//60:02d}{start%60:02d}','now_kst':_iso()}
        if cur > end:
            return {'allowed':False,'status':'PENDING','reason':'SESSION_CLOSED','session_end_hhmm':f'{end//60:02d}{end%60:02d}','now_kst':_iso()}
        return {'allowed':True,'status':'ACTIVE','reason':'IN_SESSION','session_start_minute':start,'now_minute':cur,'now_kst':_iso()}

    def _record_status(self, market, status, reason, run_id=None, started=None, errors=None):
        run_id = run_id or (_now().strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S') + f'_LSPROG_{market}')
        started = started or _iso()
        payload = [f'{status}:{reason}'] + list(errors or [])
        try:
            with self._con() as c:
                c.execute('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO ls_program_runs VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',
                          (run_id,market,status,started,_iso(),0,0,0,0,json.dumps(payload,ensure_ascii=False)))
                c.commit()
        except Exception as e:
            LOG.warning('LS_PROGRAM_STATUS_SAVE_FAILED market=%s status=%s err=%s', market, status, e)
        self.runtime_state[market] = {'status':status,'reason':reason,'run_id':run_id,'updated_at':_iso()}
        return run_id

    def _extract_candidates(self, market, ranking_rows):
        codes, seen, names = [], set(), {}
        def add(c, n=''):
            c = _code(c)
            if c and c not in seen:
                seen.add(c); codes.append(c); names[c] = str(n or '')
        for z in ranking_rows:
            add(z.get('shcode') or z.get('code') or z.get('ex_shcode'), z.get('hname') or z.get('name'))
        s = self._summary(market)
        for key in ('live_pool','entry_candidates','candidates','hotlist','top','lazy_history_candidates','close_bet_candidates','watch'):
            v = s.get(key)
            if isinstance(v, list):
                for z in v:
                    if isinstance(z, dict): add(z.get('symbol') or z.get('code') or z.get('shcode'), z.get('name'))
                    else: add(z)
        for c in os.getenv('LS_PROGRAM_PIN_CODES','').split(','): add(c)
        return codes[:self.stock_limit], names

    def _t1632(self, market, exchgubun):
        rows, errors = [], []
        now = _now()
        for gubun, segment in self._segments():
            for unit_code, unit in (('0','QTY'),('1','AMOUNT')):
                body = {'t1632InBlock': {'gubun':gubun,'gubun1':unit_code,'gubun2':'0','gubun3':'0','date':now.strftime('%Y%m%d'),'time':now.strftime('%H%M%S'),'exchgubun':exchgubun}}
                try:
                    j = self._post('t1632', body)
                    for z in j.get('t1632OutBlock1') or []:
                        q = dict(z); q['_segment']=segment; q['_unit']=unit; rows.append(q)
                except Exception as e:
                    if self._rate_limited(e): raise
                    errors.append(f't1632:{segment}:{unit}:{type(e).__name__}:{e}')
        return rows, errors

    def _t1636(self, market, exchgubun):
        rows, errors = [], []
        for gubun, segment in self._segments():
            body = {'t1636InBlock': {'gubun':gubun,'gubun1':'1','gubun2':'0','shcode':'','cts_idx':0,'exchgubun':exchgubun}}
            try:
                j = self._post('t1636', body)
                for z in j.get('t1636OutBlock1') or []:
                    q = dict(z); q['_segment']=segment; rows.append(q)
            except Exception as e:
                if self._rate_limited(e): raise
                errors.append(f't1636:{segment}:{type(e).__name__}:{e}')
        return rows, errors

    def _t1637(self, exchgubun, code):
        now = _now()
        body = {'t1637InBlock': {'gubun1':'0','gubun2':'0','shcode':code,'date':now.strftime('%Y%m%d'),'time':now.strftime('%H%M%S'),'cts_idx':9999,'exchgubun':exchgubun}}
        j = self._post('t1637', body)
        return sorted([dict(z) for z in (j.get('t1637OutBlock1') or [])], key=lambda z: _hms(z.get('time')) or -1)

    def _save_market(self, c, run_id, market, rows):
        for z in rows:
            c.execute('INSERT INTO ls_program_market(run_id,market,segment,unit,date,time,total_net,total_buy,total_sell,arb_net,arb_buy,arb_sell,nonarb_net,nonarb_buy,nonarb_sell,raw_json) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',
              (run_id,market,z.get('_segment'),z.get('_unit'),str(z.get('date') or ''),str(z.get('time') or ''),_num(z.get('tot3')),_num(z.get('tot1')),_num(z.get('tot2')),_num(z.get('cha3')),_num(z.get('cha1')),_num(z.get('cha2')),_num(z.get('bcha3')),_num(z.get('bcha1')),_num(z.get('bcha2')),json.dumps(z,ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':'))))

    def _save_rank(self, c, run_id, market, rows):
        for z in rows:
            c.execute('INSERT INTO ls_program_ranking(run_id,market,segment,rank_no,code,name,price,change_pct,net_qty,buy_qty,sell_qty,net_amt,buy_amt,sell_amt,raw_json) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',
              (run_id,market,z.get('_segment'),int(_num(z.get('rank'),0) or 0),_code(z.get('shcode') or z.get('code') or z.get('ex_shcode')),str(z.get('hname') or z.get('name') or ''),_num(z.get('price')),_num(z.get('diff')),_num(z.get('svolume')),_num(z.get('stksvolume')),_num(z.get('offervolume')),_num(z.get('svalue')),_num(z.get('stksvalue')),_num(z.get('offervalue')),json.dumps(z,ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':'))))

    def _save_stock(self, c, run_id, market, code, name, rows):
        for z in rows:
            c.execute('INSERT INTO ls_program_stock(run_id,market,code,name,date,time,price,change_pct,volume,net_qty,buy_qty,sell_qty,net_amt,buy_amt,sell_amt,raw_json) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',
              (run_id,market,code,str(name or z.get('hname') or ''),str(z.get('date') or ''),str(z.get('time') or ''),_num(z.get('price')),_num(z.get('diff')),_num(z.get('volume')),_num(z.get('svolume')),_num(z.get('stksvolume')),_num(z.get('offervolume')),_num(z.get('svalue')),_num(z.get('stksvalue')),_num(z.get('offervalue')),json.dumps(z,ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':'))))

    def collect_market(self, market):
        market = str(market or 'KRX').upper()
        if market not in {'KRX','NXT'}: return {'status':'INVALID_MARKET','market':market}

        gate = self._session_state(market)
        if not gate.get('allowed'):
            status, reason = gate.get('status','PENDING'), gate.get('reason','WAITING_SESSION')
            rid = self._record_status(market, status, reason)
            self.runtime_state[market] = {**gate,'run_id':rid,'updated_at':_iso()}
            LOG.info('LS_PROGRAM_LEDGER_PENDING market=%s status=%s reason=%s retry_after=%s', market,status,reason,gate.get('retry_after_seconds'))
            return {'status':status,'market':market,'run_id':rid,'reason':reason,**{k:v for k,v in gate.items() if k not in {'allowed','status','reason'}}}

        if not self.run_lock.acquire(blocking=False): return {'status':'SKIPPED_BUSY','market':market}
        exchgubun = 'N' if market == 'NXT' else 'K'
        run_id = _now().strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S') + f'_LSPROG_{market}'
        started, errors = _iso(), []
        try:
            market_rows, e = self._t1632(market, exchgubun); errors += e
            rank_rows, e = self._t1636(market, exchgubun); errors += e
            codes, names = self._extract_candidates(market, rank_rows)
            stock_data, success = [], 0
            for code in codes:
                try:
                    rows = self._t1637(exchgubun, code)
                    if rows: stock_data.append((code,names.get(code,''),rows)); success += 1
                    else: errors.append(f't1637:{code}:EMPTY')
                except Exception as e:
                    if self._rate_limited(e): raise
                    errors.append(f't1637:{code}:{type(e).__name__}:{e}')

            if market_rows or success:
                status = 'READY' if not errors else 'PARTIAL'
            elif rank_rows:
                status = 'PARTIAL'
            else:
                # 200/정상응답이지만 데이터가 아직 없는 경우를 장애로 오판하지 않는다.
                start_min = int(gate.get('session_start_minute') or 0)
                now_min = int(gate.get('now_minute') or 0)
                status = 'PENDING_DATA' if (now_min - start_min) <= self.empty_grace_minutes else 'DEGRADED_EMPTY'

            with self._con() as c:
                c.execute('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO ls_program_runs VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)', (run_id,market,status,started,_iso(),len(codes),success,len(market_rows),len(rank_rows),json.dumps(errors,ensure_ascii=False)))
                self._save_market(c,run_id,market,market_rows); self._save_rank(c,run_id,market,rank_rows)
                for code,name,rows in stock_data: self._save_stock(c,run_id,market,code,name,rows)
                old = c.execute('SELECT run_id FROM ls_program_runs WHERE market=? ORDER BY completed_at DESC LIMIT -1 OFFSET ?', (market,self.retention_runs)).fetchall()
                for z in old:
                    rid=z[0]
                    for t in ('ls_program_market','ls_program_ranking','ls_program_stock'): c.execute(f'DELETE FROM {t} WHERE run_id=?',(rid,))
                    c.execute('DELETE FROM ls_program_runs WHERE run_id=?',(rid,))
                c.commit()
            self.last_error = None if status in {'READY','PARTIAL','PENDING_DATA'} else f'{status}: empty program output'
            self.runtime_state[market] = {'status':status,'reason':'DATA_OK' if status in {'READY','PARTIAL'} else 'EMPTY_PROGRAM_OUTPUT','run_id':run_id,'updated_at':_iso()}
            LOG.info('LS_PROGRAM_LEDGER_DONE market=%s run=%s status=%s candidates=%s stock_ok=%s market_rows=%s rank_rows=%s errors=%s', market,run_id,status,len(codes),success,len(market_rows),len(rank_rows),len(errors))
            return {'status':status,'market':market,'run_id':run_id,'candidates':len(codes),'stock_success':success,'market_rows':len(market_rows),'ranking_rows':len(rank_rows),'errors':errors[:20]}
        except Exception as e:
            self.last_error = f'{type(e).__name__}: {e}'
            if self._rate_limited(e):
                self._rate_limit_until = time.monotonic() + self.rate_limit_cooldown_seconds
                rid = self._record_status(market, 'RATE_LIMITED', 'IGW00201_OR_429', run_id=run_id, started=started, errors=[self.last_error])
                self.runtime_state[market] = {'status':'RATE_LIMITED','reason':'IGW00201_OR_429','run_id':rid,'cooldown_seconds':self.rate_limit_cooldown_seconds,'updated_at':_iso()}
                LOG.warning('LS_PROGRAM_RATE_LIMITED market=%s cooldown=%ss err=%s', market,self.rate_limit_cooldown_seconds,self.last_error[:240])
                return {'status':'RATE_LIMITED','market':market,'run_id':rid,'error':self.last_error,'cooldown_seconds':self.rate_limit_cooldown_seconds}
            self._record_status(market, 'FAILED', 'EXCEPTION', run_id=run_id, started=started, errors=[self.last_error])
            LOG.exception('LS_PROGRAM_LEDGER_FAILED market=%s', market)
            return {'status':'FAILED','market':market,'run_id':run_id,'error':self.last_error}
        finally:
            self.run_lock.release()

    def _loop(self):
        time.sleep(self.start_delay)
        while True:
            started = time.monotonic()
            # NXT를 먼저 확인하면 08:00~09:00에는 NXT만 활성화되고 KRX는 무호출 PENDING이 된다.
            for market in ('NXT','KRX'):
                try: self.collect_market(market)
                except Exception: LOG.exception('LS_PROGRAM loop market=%s', market)
            time.sleep(max(60, self.interval - (time.monotonic()-started)))

    def start(self):
        if self.enabled:
            threading.Thread(target=self._loop, daemon=True, name='ls-program-ledger').start()
            LOG.info('LS_PROGRAM_LEDGER_STARTED version=%s interval=%ss stock_limit=%s session_guard=%s NXT=%s-%s KRX=%s-%s cooldown=%ss', self.VERSION,self.interval,self.stock_limit,self.session_guard,self.nxt_start,self.nxt_end,self.krx_start,self.krx_end,self.rate_limit_cooldown_seconds)

    def latest_run(self, market):
        with self._con() as c:
            r = c.execute('SELECT * FROM ls_program_runs WHERE market=? ORDER BY completed_at DESC LIMIT 1',(market,)).fetchone()
        return dict(r) if r else None

    def _stock_rows(self, market, code, limit=300):
        with self._con() as c:
            rid = c.execute('SELECT run_id FROM ls_program_stock WHERE market=? AND code=? ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1',(market,code)).fetchone()
            if not rid: return []
            rows = c.execute('SELECT * FROM ls_program_stock WHERE run_id=? AND market=? AND code=? ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT ?',(rid[0],market,code,max(1,min(int(limit),1000)))).fetchall()
        return [dict(r) for r in rows]

    def _trend(self, rows):
        if not rows: return {'status':'NO_DATA'}
        rows = sorted(rows, key=lambda r:_hms(r.get('time')) or -1)
        last, lt = rows[-1], _hms(rows[-1].get('time'))
        out = {'status':'READY','asof_time':last.get('time'),'price':last.get('price'),'net_qty':last.get('net_qty'),'net_amt':last.get('net_amt')}
        for mins in (10,20,30):
            prev = None
            if lt is not None:
                target = lt - mins*60
                cand = [r for r in rows if _hms(r.get('time')) is not None and _hms(r.get('time')) <= target]
                prev = cand[-1] if cand else None
            dq = (last.get('net_qty')-prev.get('net_qty')) if prev and last.get('net_qty') is not None and prev.get('net_qty') is not None else None
            da = (last.get('net_amt')-prev.get('net_amt')) if prev and last.get('net_amt') is not None and prev.get('net_amt') is not None else None
            out[f'delta_{mins}m_qty'] = dq; out[f'delta_{mins}m_amt'] = da
            out[f'velocity_{mins}m_qty_per_min'] = dq/mins if dq is not None else None
            out[f'velocity_{mins}m_amt_per_min'] = da/mins if da is not None else None
        d10, d20 = out.get('delta_10m_qty'), out.get('delta_20m_qty')
        if d10 is None: state='WARMUP'
        elif d10 > 0 and (d20 or 0) > 0: state='PROGRAM_BUY_ACCEL'
        elif d10 > 0: state='PROGRAM_BUY_TURN'
        elif d10 < 0 and (d20 or 0) < 0: state='PROGRAM_SELL_ACCEL'
        elif d10 < 0: state='PROGRAM_SELL_TURN'
        else: state='PROGRAM_FLAT'
        out['trend_state'] = state
        return out

    def stock_view(self, market, code, limit=300):
        market, code = str(market or 'KRX').upper(), _code(code)
        rows = self._stock_rows(market, code, limit)
        return {'version':self.VERSION,'market':market,'code':code,'trend':self._trend(rows),'rows':rows}

    def market_view(self, market, segment=None, unit='AMOUNT', limit=300):
        market = str(market or 'KRX').upper(); run = self.latest_run(market)
        if not run: return {'version':self.VERSION,'market':market,'status':'NO_DATA','rows':[]}
        q='SELECT * FROM ls_program_market WHERE run_id=? AND market=?'; args=[run['run_id'],market]
        if segment: q+=' AND segment=?'; args.append(str(segment).upper())
        if unit: q+=' AND unit=?'; args.append(str(unit).upper())
        q+=' ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT ?'; args.append(max(1,min(int(limit),1000)))
        with self._con() as c: rows=[dict(r) for r in c.execute(q,args).fetchall()]
        return {'version':self.VERSION,'market':market,'run':run,'rows':rows}

    def top_view(self, market, limit=30):
        market = str(market or 'KRX').upper(); run = self.latest_run(market)
        if not run: return {'version':self.VERSION,'market':market,'status':'NO_DATA','buy':[],'sell':[]}
        with self._con() as c:
            rows=[dict(r) for r in c.execute('SELECT * FROM ls_program_stock WHERE run_id=? AND market=? ORDER BY id ASC',(run['run_id'],market)).fetchall()]
        by={}
        for r in rows: by.setdefault(r['code'],[]).append(r)
        items=[]
        for code, rr in by.items():
            tr=self._trend(rr); items.append({'code':code,'name':rr[-1].get('name'),**tr})
        def score(x): return x.get('delta_10m_amt') if x.get('delta_10m_amt') is not None else (x.get('net_amt') or 0)
        n=max(1,min(int(limit),100))
        return {'version':self.VERSION,'market':market,'run':run,'buy':sorted(items,key=score,reverse=True)[:n],'sell':sorted(items,key=score)[:n]}

    def health(self):
        remain = int(max(0, self._rate_limit_until - time.monotonic()))
        return {
            'ok':True,'version':self.VERSION,'enabled':self.enabled,
            'interval_seconds':self.interval,'stock_limit_per_market':self.stock_limit,'db_path':str(self.db_path),
            'session_guard_enabled':self.session_guard,
            'session_windows':{'NXT':f'{self.nxt_start}-{self.nxt_end}','KRX':f'{self.krx_start}-{self.krx_end}'},
            'rate_limit_cooldown_remaining_seconds':remain,
            'runtime_state':self.runtime_state,
            'latest':{'KRX':self.latest_run('KRX'),'NXT':self.latest_run('NXT')},
            'last_error':self.last_error,
            'policy':'LS_INDEPENDENT_AUXILIARY__NEVER_OVERWRITE_KIS_AUTHORITY__PREOPEN_NO_TR__ZERO_ROWS_NOT_FATAL'
        }

    def handle_get(self, raw_path):
        u=urlparse(raw_path); path=u.path; qs=parse_qs(u.query); market=(qs.get('market') or ['KRX'])[0].upper()
        if path=='/api/context/ls-program/health': return 200,self.health()
        if path=='/api/context/ls-program/latest': return 200,{'health':self.health(),'top':self.top_view(market,int((qs.get('limit') or ['30'])[0]))}
        if path=='/api/context/ls-program/top': return 200,self.top_view(market,int((qs.get('limit') or ['30'])[0]))
        if path=='/api/context/ls-program/stock': return 200,self.stock_view(market,(qs.get('code') or [''])[0],int((qs.get('limit') or ['300'])[0]))
        if path=='/api/context/ls-program/market': return 200,self.market_view(market,(qs.get('segment') or [None])[0],(qs.get('unit') or ['AMOUNT'])[0],int((qs.get('limit') or ['300'])[0]))
        return None

LS_PROGRAM_LEDGER = LSProgramTrendLedger()
