def _require_ohlcv(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    required = ["open", "high", "low", "close", "volume"]
    missing = [c for c in required if c not in df.columns]
    if missing:
        raise ValueError(f"필수 컬럼 누락: {missing}")
    out = df.copy()
    for c in required:
        out[c] = pd.to_numeric(out[c], errors="coerce")
    return out


def _rsi(close: pd.Series, period: int = 14) -> pd.Series:
    delta = close.diff()
    gain = delta.clip(lower=0)
    loss = -delta.clip(upper=0)
    avg_gain = gain.ewm(alpha=1 / period, adjust=False, min_periods=period).mean()
    avg_loss = loss.ewm(alpha=1 / period, adjust=False, min_periods=period).mean()
    rs = avg_gain / avg_loss.replace(0, np.nan)
    rsi = 100 - (100 / (1 + rs))
    return rsi.fillna(50.0)


def _macd(close: pd.Series, fast: int, slow: int, signal: int) -> Tuple[pd.Series, pd.Series, pd.Series]:
    ema_fast = close.ewm(span=fast, adjust=False).mean()
    ema_slow = close.ewm(span=slow, adjust=False).mean()
    line = ema_fast - ema_slow
    sig = line.ewm(span=signal, adjust=False).mean()
    hist = line - sig
    return line, sig, hist


def _session_vwap(group: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    g = group.copy()
    tp = (g["high"] + g["low"] + g["close"]) / 3.0
    vol = g["volume"].clip(lower=0).fillna(0.0)

    cum_v = vol.cumsum().replace(0, np.nan)
    cum_pv = (tp * vol).cumsum()
    cum_p2v = ((tp ** 2) * vol).cumsum()

    vwap = cum_pv / cum_v
    variance = (cum_p2v / cum_v) - (vwap ** 2)
    sd = np.sqrt(variance.clip(lower=0))

    g["typical_price"] = tp
    g["vwap"] = vwap
    g["vwap_sd"] = sd
    g["vwap_u1"] = vwap + sd
    g["vwap_l1"] = vwap - sd
    g["vwap_u2"] = vwap + 2 * sd
    g["vwap_l2"] = vwap - 2 * sd
    return g


def add_indicators(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    config: Optional[VWAPConfig] = None,
    session_col: Optional[str] = None,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    cfg = config or VWAPConfig()
    x = _require_ohlcv(df)

    if session_col and session_col in x.columns:
        parts = []
        for _, g in x.groupby(session_col, sort=False, group_keys=False):
            parts.append(_session_vwap(g))
        x = pd.concat(parts).sort_index()
        x["bar_no"] = x.groupby(session_col).cumcount() + 1
        # 세션별로 기울기 초기화
        x["vwap_slope"] = x.groupby(session_col)["vwap"].diff()
    else:
        x = _session_vwap(x)
        x["bar_no"] = np.arange(1, len(x) + 1)
        x["vwap_slope"] = x["vwap"].diff()

    x["volume_ma20"] = x["volume"].rolling(cfg.volume_ma_period, min_periods=5).mean()
    x["volume_ratio"] = x["volume"] / x["volume_ma20"].replace(0, np.nan)

    x["rsi14"] = _rsi(x["close"], cfg.rsi_period)
    macd, macd_sig, macd_hist = _macd(x["close"], cfg.macd_fast, cfg.macd_slow, cfg.macd_signal)
    x["macd"] = macd
    x["macd_signal"] = macd_sig
    x["macd_hist"] = macd_hist

    x["bullish"] = x["close"] > x["open"]
    x["bearish"] = x["close"] < x["open"]

    body = (x["close"] - x["open"]).abs()
    candle_range = (x["high"] - x["low"]).replace(0, np.nan)
    lower_wick = np.minimum(x["open"], x["close"]) - x["low"]
    upper_wick = x["high"] - np.maximum(x["open"], x["close"])

    x["doji"] = (body / candle_range) <= 0.15
    x["hammer"] = (lower_wick >= body * 2.0) & (upper_wick <= body * 1.2)
    x["shooting_star"] = (upper_wick >= body * 2.0) & (lower_wick <= body * 1.2)

    x["rsi_cross_up_50"] = (x["rsi14"] > 50) & (x["rsi14"].shift(1) <= 50)
    x["rsi_cross_down_50"] = (x["rsi14"] < 50) & (x["rsi14"].shift(1) >= 50)
    x["rsi_exit_oversold"] = (x["rsi14"] > 30) & (x["rsi14"].shift(1) <= 30)
    x["rsi_exit_overbought"] = (x["rsi14"] < 70) & (x["rsi14"].shift(1) >= 70)

    x["macd_golden"] = (x["macd"] > x["macd_signal"]) & (x["macd"].shift(1) <= x["macd_signal"].shift(1))
    x["macd_dead"] = (x["macd"] < x["macd_signal"]) & (x["macd"].shift(1) >= x["macd_signal"].shift(1))

    near = ((x["close"] - x["vwap"]).abs() / x["vwap"].replace(0, np.nan)) <= cfg.near_vwap_pct
    x["near_vwap"] = near

    # 박스는 현재봉을 제외한 직전 구간 기준
    x["box_high_prev"] = x["high"].shift(1).rolling(
        cfg.box_lookback, min_periods=max(3, cfg.box_lookback // 2)
    ).max()
    x["box_low_prev"] = x["low"].shift(1).rolling(
        cfg.box_lookback, min_periods=max(3, cfg.box_lookback // 2)
    ).min()
    roll_mid = ((x["box_high_prev"] + x["box_low_prev"]) / 2).replace(0, np.nan)
    x["box_width_pct"] = (x["box_high_prev"] - x["box_low_prev"]) / roll_mid
    x["box_compressed"] = x["box_width_pct"] <= cfg.box_max_width_pct
    x["near_vwap_ratio"] = near.shift(1).rolling(cfg.box_lookback, min_periods=3).mean()

    return x


def _rr(entry: float, stop: float, target: float, side: str = "LONG") -> float:
    vals = [entry, stop, target]
    if not all(np.isfinite(v) for v in vals):
        return np.nan
    if side == "LONG":
        risk = entry - stop
        reward = target - entry
    else:
        risk = stop - entry
        reward = entry - target
    if risk <= 0:
        return np.nan
    return reward / risk


def _breakout_long_stop_row(r: pd.Series, cfg: VWAPConfig) -> float:
    """BREAKOUT 전용 손절: 가장 가까운 유효 지지선, 단 최대 손절폭 4% 제한."""
    entry = float(r["close"])
    candidates = [entry * (1 - cfg.breakout_stop_cap_pct)]

    if pd.notna(r.get("vwap")) and float(r["vwap"]) < entry:
        candidates.append(float(r["vwap"]) * (1 - cfg.breakout_support_buffer_pct))

    if pd.notna(r.get("box_low_prev")) and float(r["box_low_prev"]) < entry:
        candidates.append(float(r["box_low_prev"]) * (1 - cfg.breakout_support_buffer_pct))

    # 가장 높은(=진입가에 가장 가까운) 지지 손절선을 채택
    stop = max(candidates)
    # 비정상적으로 entry 이상이 되는 경우 안전장치
    return min(stop, entry * 0.999)


def evaluate_signals(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    config: Optional[VWAPConfig] = None,
    session_col: Optional[str] = None,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    cfg = config or VWAPConfig()
    x = add_indicators(df, cfg, session_col=session_col)

    # 1) VWAP 중앙선 추세매매
    vwap_touch_long = (
        (x["low"] <= x["vwap"] * 1.002)
        & (x["close"] >= x["vwap"])
        & x["bullish"]
        & (x["vwap_slope"] > 0)
    )
    vwap_touch_short = (
        (x["high"] >= x["vwap"] * 0.998)
        & (x["close"] <= x["vwap"])
        & x["bearish"]
        & (x["vwap_slope"] < 0)
    )

    # 2) ±2SD 평균회귀
    mean_rev_long = (
        (x["low"] <= x["vwap_l2"])
        & (x["close"] > x["vwap_l2"])
        & (x["bullish"] | x["hammer"] | x["doji"])
    )
    mean_rev_short = (
        (x["high"] >= x["vwap_u2"])
        & (x["close"] < x["vwap_u2"])
        & (x["bearish"] | x["shooting_star"] | x["doji"])
    )

    # 3) 거래량 폭발 돌파
    breakout_long = (
        (x["near_vwap_ratio"] >= 0.50)
        & x["box_compressed"].fillna(False)
        & (x["close"] > x["vwap"])
        & (x["close"] > x["vwap_u1"])
        & (x["volume_ratio"] >= cfg.breakout_volume_ratio_min)
        & x["bullish"]
    )
    breakout_short = (
        (x["near_vwap_ratio"] >= 0.50)
        & x["box_compressed"].fillna(False)
        & (x["close"] < x["vwap"])
        & (x["close"] < x["vwap_l1"])
        & (x["volume_ratio"] >= cfg.breakout_volume_ratio_min)
        & x["bearish"]
    )

    x["strategy_trend_long"] = vwap_touch_long
    x["strategy_trend_short"] = vwap_touch_short
    x["strategy_meanrev_long"] = mean_rev_long
    x["strategy_meanrev_short"] = mean_rev_short
    x["strategy_breakout_long"] = breakout_long
    x["strategy_breakout_short"] = breakout_short

    # 다중 수렴
    x["confluence_rsi_long"] = x["rsi_cross_up_50"] | x["rsi_exit_oversold"]
    x["confluence_rsi_short"] = x["rsi_cross_down_50"] | x["rsi_exit_overbought"]
    x["confluence_macd_long"] = x["macd_golden"] | (x["macd_hist"] > 0)
    x["confluence_macd_short"] = x["macd_dead"] | (x["macd_hist"] < 0)
    x["confluence_volume_long"] = x["volume_ratio"] >= 2.0
    x["confluence_volume_short"] = x["volume_ratio"] >= 2.0

    x["time_gate"] = x["bar_no"] >= cfg.min_bars_after_open
    x["raw_long"] = vwap_touch_long | mean_rev_long | breakout_long
    x["raw_short"] = vwap_touch_short | mean_rev_short | breakout_short

    long_strategy_points = (
        vwap_touch_long.astype(int) + mean_rev_long.astype(int) + breakout_long.astype(int)
    ) * 2
    short_strategy_points = (
        vwap_touch_short.astype(int) + mean_rev_short.astype(int) + breakout_short.astype(int)
    ) * 2

    x["long_score"] = (
        long_strategy_points
        + x["confluence_rsi_long"].astype(int)
        + x["confluence_macd_long"].astype(int)
        + x["confluence_volume_long"].astype(int)
    )
    x["short_score"] = (
        short_strategy_points
        + x["confluence_rsi_short"].astype(int)
        + x["confluence_macd_short"].astype(int)
        + x["confluence_volume_short"].astype(int)
    )

    # 기존 TREND/MEANREV 손절/목표
    long_stop_vwap = x["vwap"] * 0.998
    long_stop_pct = x["close"] * (1 - cfg.fallback_stop_pct)
    x["long_stop"] = np.minimum(long_stop_vwap, long_stop_pct)
    x["long_target1"] = x["vwap_u1"]
    x["long_target2"] = x["vwap_u2"]

    short_stop_vwap = x["vwap"] * 1.002
    short_stop_pct = x["close"] * (1 + cfg.fallback_stop_pct)
    x["short_stop"] = np.maximum(short_stop_vwap, short_stop_pct)
    x["short_target1"] = x["vwap_l1"]
    x["short_target2"] = x["vwap_l2"]

    x["long_rr2"] = [
        _rr(e, s, t, "LONG") for e, s, t in zip(x["close"], x["long_stop"], x["long_target2"])
    ]
    x["short_rr2"] = [
        _rr(e, s, t, "SHORT") for e, s, t in zip(x["close"], x["short_stop"], x["short_target2"])
    ]
    x["rr_gate_long"] = x["long_rr2"] >= cfg.min_reward_risk
    x["rr_gate_short"] = x["short_rr2"] >= cfg.min_reward_risk

    # V1.1 BREAKOUT 전용 손절/목표
    x["breakout_stop"] = x.apply(lambda r: _breakout_long_stop_row(r, cfg), axis=1)
    x["breakout_target10"] = x["close"] * (1 + cfg.breakout_target10_pct)
    x["breakout_target15"] = x["close"] * (1 + cfg.breakout_target15_pct)
    x["breakout_target20"] = x["close"] * (1 + cfg.breakout_target20_pct)
    x["breakout_rr10"] = [
        _rr(e, s, t, "LONG") for e, s, t in zip(x["close"], x["breakout_stop"], x["breakout_target10"])
    ]
    x["breakout_rr15"] = [
        _rr(e, s, t, "LONG") for e, s, t in zip(x["close"], x["breakout_stop"], x["breakout_target15"])
    ]
    x["breakout_rr20"] = [
        _rr(e, s, t, "LONG") for e, s, t in zip(x["close"], x["breakout_stop"], x["breakout_target20"])
    ]
    x["breakout_rr_gate"] = x["breakout_rr10"] >= cfg.min_reward_risk

    # V1.1 사전 SETUP: 강한 BUY가 아니라 '폭발 준비' 관찰 신호
    x["explosion_setup_long"] = (
        x["time_gate"]
        & (x["close"] >= x["vwap"])
        & (x["vwap_slope"] > 0)
        & (x["volume_ratio"] >= cfg.setup_volume_ratio_min)
        & (x["rsi14"] >= cfg.setup_rsi_min)
        & (x["macd_hist"] >= 0)
        & (x["near_vwap_ratio"] >= cfg.setup_near_vwap_ratio_min)
    )

    # 최종 BUY를 전략별 RR로 분리
    x["action_long_standard"] = (
        x["time_gate"]
        & (vwap_touch_long | mean_rev_long)
        & (x["long_score"] >= cfg.actionable_score)
        & x["rr_gate_long"].fillna(False)
    )
    x["action_long_breakout"] = (
        x["time_gate"]
        & breakout_long
        & (x["long_score"] >= cfg.actionable_score)
        & x["breakout_rr_gate"].fillna(False)
    )
    x["action_long"] = x["action_long_standard"] | x["action_long_breakout"]

    # SHORT는 V1.0 보존
    x["action_short"] = (
        x["time_gate"]
        & x["raw_short"]
        & (x["short_score"] >= cfg.actionable_score)
        & x["rr_gate_short"].fillna(False)
    )

    # 폭등 탐지용 통합 상태
    x["explosion_watch_long"] = x["explosion_setup_long"] | breakout_long | vwap_touch_long
    x["explosion_action_long"] = x["action_long_breakout"] | x["action_long_standard"]

    states: List[str] = []
    names: List[str] = []
    reasons: List[str] = []

    for _, r in x.iterrows():
        if bool(r["action_long"]):
            state = "BUY"
        elif bool(r["action_short"]):
            state = "SELL"
        elif bool(r["raw_long"]) or bool(r["raw_short"]) or bool(r["explosion_setup_long"]):
            state = "WATCH"
        else:
            state = "NONE"

        tags = []
        if bool(r["explosion_setup_long"]): tags.append("EXPLOSION_SETUP")
        if bool(r["strategy_trend_long"]): tags.append("TREND_LONG")
        if bool(r["strategy_trend_short"]): tags.append("TREND_SHORT")
        if bool(r["strategy_meanrev_long"]): tags.append("MEANREV_LONG")
        if bool(r["strategy_meanrev_short"]): tags.append("MEANREV_SHORT")
        if bool(r["strategy_breakout_long"]): tags.append("BREAKOUT_LONG")
        if bool(r["strategy_breakout_short"]): tags.append("BREAKOUT_SHORT")

        why = []
        if bool(r["confluence_rsi_long"]): why.append("RSI_LONG")
        if bool(r["confluence_rsi_short"]): why.append("RSI_SHORT")
        if bool(r["confluence_macd_long"]): why.append("MACD_LONG")
        if bool(r["confluence_macd_short"]): why.append("MACD_SHORT")
        if pd.notna(r["volume_ratio"]) and float(r["volume_ratio"]) >= 2.0:
            why.append(f"VOLx{float(r['volume_ratio']):.2f}")
        if not bool(r["time_gate"]): why.append("EARLY_OPEN_BLOCK")

        if bool(r["strategy_breakout_long"]):
            if bool(r["breakout_rr_gate"]):
                why.append(f"BRK_RR10_PASS:{float(r['breakout_rr10']):.2f}")
            else:
                why.append("BRK_RR10_FAIL")
        elif bool(r["raw_long"]) and not bool(r["rr_gate_long"]):
            why.append("LONG_RR_FAIL")

        if bool(r["raw_short"]) and not bool(r["rr_gate_short"]):
            why.append("SHORT_RR_FAIL")

        states.append(state)
        names.append("|".join(tags) if tags else "")
        reasons.append("|".join(why))

    x["signal"] = states
    x["strategy"] = names
    x["reason"] = reasons

    return x


def _safe_float(v):
    try:
        if pd.isna(v):
            return None
        return round(float(v), 6)
    except Exception:
        return None


def latest_decision(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    config: Optional[VWAPConfig] = None,
    session_col: Optional[str] = None,
) -> Dict:
    x = evaluate_signals(df, config=config, session_col=session_col)
    if x.empty:
        return {"engine": ENGINE_NAME, "version": ENGINE_VERSION, "signal": "NONE"}

    r = x.iloc[-1]
    is_breakout_buy = bool(r["action_long_breakout"])

    if r["signal"] == "BUY" and is_breakout_buy:
        stop = r["breakout_stop"]
        target1 = r["breakout_target10"]
        target2 = r["breakout_target15"]
        target3 = r["breakout_target20"]
        rr = r["breakout_rr10"]
        rr15 = r["breakout_rr15"]
        rr20 = r["breakout_rr20"]
        score = int(r["long_score"])
        target_mode = "BREAKOUT_10_15_20"
    elif r["signal"] == "BUY":
        stop = r["long_stop"]
        target1 = r["long_target1"]
        target2 = r["long_target2"]
        target3 = np.nan
        rr = r["long_rr2"]
        rr15 = rr20 = np.nan
        score = int(r["long_score"])
        target_mode = "VWAP_SD"
    elif r["signal"] == "SELL":
        stop = r["short_stop"]
        target1 = r["short_target1"]
        target2 = r["short_target2"]
        target3 = np.nan
        rr = r["short_rr2"]
        rr15 = rr20 = np.nan
        score = int(r["short_score"])
        target_mode = "VWAP_SD"
    else:
        stop = target1 = target2 = target3 = rr = rr15 = rr20 = np.nan
        score = int(max(r["long_score"], r["short_score"]))
        target_mode = "NONE"

    return {
        "engine": ENGINE_NAME,
        "version": ENGINE_VERSION,
        "signal": str(r["signal"]),
        "strategy": str(r["strategy"]),
        "reason": str(r["reason"]),
        "entry": _safe_float(r["close"]),
        "vwap": _safe_float(r["vwap"]),
        "vwap_u1": _safe_float(r["vwap_u1"]),
        "vwap_u2": _safe_float(r["vwap_u2"]),
        "rsi14": _safe_float(r["rsi14"]),
        "macd_hist": _safe_float(r["macd_hist"]),
        "volume_ratio": _safe_float(r["volume_ratio"]),
        "score": score,
        "target_mode": target_mode,
        "stop": _safe_float(stop),
        "target1": _safe_float(target1),
        "target2": _safe_float(target2),
        "target3": _safe_float(target3),
        "reward_risk_primary": _safe_float(rr),
        "reward_risk_15pct": _safe_float(rr15),
        "reward_risk_20pct": _safe_float(rr20),
        "explosion_setup": bool(r["explosion_setup_long"]),
        "explosion_watch": bool(r["explosion_watch_long"]),
        "explosion_action": bool(r["explosion_action_long"]),
    }


def signal_history(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    config: Optional[VWAPConfig] = None,
    session_col: Optional[str] = None,
    include_watch: bool = True,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    x = evaluate_signals(df, config=config, session_col=session_col)
    wanted = ["BUY", "SELL", "WATCH"] if include_watch else ["BUY", "SELL"]
    y = x[x["signal"].isin(wanted)].copy()

    cols = [
        c for c in [
            "datetime", "date", "time", "symbol", "name",
            "open", "high", "low", "close", "volume",
            "vwap", "vwap_u1", "vwap_u2", "vwap_l1", "vwap_l2",
            "box_high_prev", "box_low_prev", "box_width_pct",
            "volume_ratio", "rsi14", "macd_hist",
            "signal", "strategy", "reason",
            "long_score", "short_score",
            "explosion_setup_long", "explosion_watch_long", "explosion_action_long",
            "action_long_standard", "action_long_breakout",
            "long_rr2", "short_rr2",
            "breakout_stop", "breakout_target10", "breakout_target15", "breakout_target20",
            "breakout_rr10", "breakout_rr15", "breakout_rr20",
            "long_stop", "long_target1", "long_target2",
            "short_stop", "short_target1", "short_target2",
        ] if c in y.columns
    ]
    return y[cols]


def checklist_latest(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    config: Optional[VWAPConfig] = None,
    session_col: Optional[str] = None,
) -> Dict[str, object]:
    cfg = config or VWAPConfig()
    x = evaluate_signals(df, cfg, session_col=session_col)
    if x.empty:
        return {}

    r = x.iloc[-1]
    trend_clear = bool(pd.notna(r["vwap_slope"]) and abs(r["vwap_slope"]) > 0)
    volume_ok = bool(pd.notna(r["volume_ratio"]) and r["volume_ratio"] >= 1.0)
    indicator_confluence = bool(
        r["confluence_rsi_long"] or r["confluence_rsi_short"]
        or r["confluence_macd_long"] or r["confluence_macd_short"]
    )
    standard_rr_ok = bool(
        (pd.notna(r["long_rr2"]) and r["long_rr2"] >= cfg.min_reward_risk)
        or (pd.notna(r["short_rr2"]) and r["short_rr2"] >= cfg.min_reward_risk)
    )
    breakout_rr_ok = bool(pd.notna(r["breakout_rr10"]) and r["breakout_rr10"] >= cfg.min_reward_risk)

    return {
        "거래량 상태": volume_ok,
        "VWAP 중앙선 기울기 명확": trend_clear,
        "RSI/MACD 다중 수렴": indicator_confluence,
        "기존전략 RR 1.5 이상": standard_rr_ok,
        "BREAKOUT +10% RR 1.5 이상": breakout_rr_ok,
        "폭등 SETUP": bool(r["explosion_setup_long"]),
        "폭등 WATCH": bool(r["explosion_watch_long"]),
        "폭등 ACTION": bool(r["explosion_action_long"]),
        "장초 최소봉 경과": bool(r["time_gate"]),
    }


def _first_pos_where(mask: pd.Series) -> Optional[int]:
    arr = np.flatnonzero(mask.fillna(False).to_numpy())
    return int(arr[0]) if len(arr) else None


def _signal_before_touch(
    day: pd.DataFrame,
    touch_pos: Optional[int],
    signal_col: str,
) -> Tuple[bool, Optional[int]]:
    """
    strict-before-touch: 목표가를 처음 찍은 봉보다 '이전 봉'에서 신호가 확정되어야 사전포착.
    동일 봉 신호는 look-ahead 방지를 위해 불인정.
    """
    if touch_pos is None or touch_pos <= 0 or signal_col not in day.columns:
        return False, None
    before = day.iloc[:touch_pos]
    pos = _first_pos_where(before[signal_col])
    return (pos is not None), pos


def backtest_target_detection(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    session_col: str,
    config: Optional[VWAPConfig] = None,
    event_threshold_pct: float = 0.20,
    target_pcts: Sequence[float] = (0.10, 0.15, 0.20),
    prior_lookback_sessions: int = 5,
) -> Tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    """
    +20% 등 급등 이벤트를 자동 식별하고 목표가 도달 전 탐지율을 계산한다.

    이벤트 정의:
      당일 최고가 / 직전 거래일 종가 - 1 >= event_threshold_pct

    사전포착 정의:
      - ACTION: explosion_action_long이 목표가 최초 터치 봉 '이전'에 발생
      - WATCH : explosion_watch_long이 목표가 최초 터치 봉 '이전'에 발생
      - PRIOR : 급등일 이전 최대 prior_lookback_sessions 거래일에 신호 발생

    반환:
      event_table, summary_table
    """
    if not session_col or session_col not in df.columns:
        raise ValueError("backtest_target_detection에는 유효한 session_col이 반드시 필요합니다.")

    cfg = config or VWAPConfig()
    x = evaluate_signals(df, cfg, session_col=session_col).copy()
    sessions = list(pd.unique(x[session_col]))
    rows: List[Dict] = []

    for i in range(1, len(sessions)):
        session = sessions[i]
        prev_session = sessions[i - 1]
        day = x[x[session_col] == session].copy()
        prev_day = x[x[session_col] == prev_session]
        if day.empty or prev_day.empty:
            continue

        prev_close = float(prev_day.iloc[-1]["close"])
        if not np.isfinite(prev_close) or prev_close <= 0:
            continue

        peak = float(day["high"].max())
        peak_pct = peak / prev_close - 1
        if peak_pct < event_threshold_pct:
            continue

        # 이전 1~N거래일에서 가장 먼저 발견된 신호
        prior_sessions = sessions[max(0, i - prior_lookback_sessions):i]
        prior = x[x[session_col].isin(prior_sessions)]
        prior_action_hit = bool(prior["explosion_action_long"].fillna(False).any())
        prior_watch_hit = bool(prior["explosion_watch_long"].fillna(False).any())

        prior_action_first = prior[prior["explosion_action_long"].fillna(False)].head(1)
        prior_watch_first = prior[prior["explosion_watch_long"].fillna(False)].head(1)

        row: Dict = {
            "session": session,
            "prev_session": prev_session,
            "prev_close": prev_close,
            "day_peak": peak,
            "day_peak_pct": peak_pct * 100,
            "prior5_action": prior_action_hit,
            "prior5_watch": prior_watch_hit,
            "prior_action_session": None if prior_action_first.empty else prior_action_first.iloc[0][session_col],
            "prior_watch_session": None if prior_watch_first.empty else prior_watch_first.iloc[0][session_col],
        }

        # 식별용 선택 컬럼 보존
        for c in ["symbol", "code", "name"]:
            if c in day.columns:
                row[c] = day.iloc[0][c]

        for pct in target_pcts:
            label = f"{int(round(pct * 100))}"
            threshold_price = prev_close * (1 + pct)
            touch_pos = _first_pos_where(day["high"] >= threshold_price)
            row[f"target{label}_price"] = threshold_price
            row[f"target{label}_reached"] = touch_pos is not None

            if touch_pos is not None:
                touch_row = day.iloc[touch_pos]
                row[f"target{label}_touch_bar_no"] = int(touch_row["bar_no"])
                if "time" in day.columns:
                    row[f"target{label}_touch_time"] = touch_row.get("time")
                elif "datetime" in day.columns:
                    row[f"target{label}_touch_time"] = touch_row.get("datetime")
                else:
                    row[f"target{label}_touch_time"] = day.index[touch_pos]
            else:
                row[f"target{label}_touch_bar_no"] = None
                row[f"target{label}_touch_time"] = None

            action_hit, action_pos = _signal_before_touch(day, touch_pos, "explosion_action_long")
            watch_hit, watch_pos = _signal_before_touch(day, touch_pos, "explosion_watch_long")
            setup_hit, setup_pos = _signal_before_touch(day, touch_pos, "explosion_setup_long")
            breakout_hit, breakout_pos = _signal_before_touch(day, touch_pos, "action_long_breakout")

            row[f"pre{label}_action"] = action_hit
            row[f"pre{label}_watch"] = watch_hit
            row[f"pre{label}_setup"] = setup_hit
            row[f"pre{label}_breakout_buy"] = breakout_hit

            for kind, pos in [
                ("action", action_pos),
                ("watch", watch_pos),
                ("setup", setup_pos),
                ("breakout_buy", breakout_pos),
            ]:
                if pos is not None:
                    sigrow = day.iloc[pos]
                    row[f"pre{label}_{kind}_bar_no"] = int(sigrow["bar_no"])
                    row[f"pre{label}_{kind}_price"] = float(sigrow["close"])
                    row[f"pre{label}_{kind}_gain_pct"] = (float(sigrow["close"]) / prev_close - 1) * 100
                    if "time" in day.columns:
                        row[f"pre{label}_{kind}_time"] = sigrow.get("time")
                    elif "datetime" in day.columns:
                        row[f"pre{label}_{kind}_time"] = sigrow.get("datetime")
                    else:
                        row[f"pre{label}_{kind}_time"] = day.index[pos]
                else:
                    row[f"pre{label}_{kind}_bar_no"] = None
                    row[f"pre{label}_{kind}_price"] = None
                    row[f"pre{label}_{kind}_gain_pct"] = None
                    row[f"pre{label}_{kind}_time"] = None

        rows.append(row)

    events = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    summary_rows: List[Dict] = []
    n = len(events)

    if n:
        summary_rows.append({
            "metric": "EVENTS",
            "count": n,
            "denominator": n,
            "rate_pct": 100.0,
        })
        for pct in target_pcts:
            label = f"{int(round(pct * 100))}"
            reached = events[f"target{label}_reached"].fillna(False)
            denom = int(reached.sum())
            for kind in ["action", "breakout_buy", "watch", "setup"]:
                col = f"pre{label}_{kind}"
                hits = int((events[col].fillna(False) & reached).sum())
                summary_rows.append({
                    "metric": f"PRE_{label}_{kind.upper()}",
                    "count": hits,
                    "denominator": denom,
                    "rate_pct": (100.0 * hits / denom) if denom else np.nan,
                })

        for kind in ["action", "watch"]:
            col = f"prior5_{kind}"
            hits = int(events[col].fillna(False).sum())
            summary_rows.append({
                "metric": f"PRIOR_{prior_lookback_sessions}D_{kind.upper()}",
                "count": hits,
                "denominator": n,
                "rate_pct": 100.0 * hits / n,
            })

    summary = pd.DataFrame(summary_rows)
    return events, summary


def load_csv(path: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = pd.read_csv(path)
    aliases = {
        "시가": "open", "고가": "high", "저가": "low", "종가": "close", "거래량": "volume",
        "Open": "open", "High": "high", "Low": "low", "Close": "close", "Volume": "volume",
    }
    return df.rename(columns={k: v for k, v in aliases.items() if k in df.columns})


def main():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="VWAP 거래량 폭등탐지 V1.1")
    p.add_argument("--csv", required=True, help="OHLCV CSV 경로")
    p.add_argument("--session-col", default=None, help="거래일 세션 컬럼명(예: date)")
    p.add_argument("--out", default=None, help="전체 신호 포함 CSV 저장 경로")
    p.add_argument("--backtest", action="store_true", help="+20%% 급등 사전포착 백테스트 실행")
    p.add_argument("--event-threshold", type=float, default=20.0, help="급등 이벤트 고가 기준(%%), 기본 20")
    p.add_argument("--lookback", type=int, default=5, help="급등 전 탐색 거래일 수, 기본 5")
    p.add_argument("--backtest-out", default=None, help="이벤트별 백테스트 CSV 저장 경로")
    p.add_argument("--summary-out", default=None, help="백테스트 요약 CSV 저장 경로")
    args = p.parse_args()

    df = load_csv(args.csv)
    result = evaluate_signals(df, session_col=args.session_col)
    decision = latest_decision(df, session_col=args.session_col)

    print("=" * 78)
    print(f"{ENGINE_NAME} {ENGINE_VERSION}")
    print("=" * 78)
    print(json.dumps(decision, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str))

    print("\n[체크리스트]")
    for k, v in checklist_latest(df, session_col=args.session_col).items():
        print(f"- {k}: {'PASS' if v else 'FAIL'}")

    if args.out:
        result.to_csv(args.out, index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
        print(f"\n신호 저장 완료: {args.out}")

    if args.backtest:
        if not args.session_col:
            raise SystemExit("--backtest 사용 시 --session-col 이 필요합니다.")
        events, summary = backtest_target_detection(
            df,
            session_col=args.session_col,
            event_threshold_pct=args.event_threshold / 100.0,
            target_pcts=(0.10, 0.15, 0.20),
            prior_lookback_sessions=args.lookback,
        )
        print("\n[+20% 급등 사전포착 백테스트 요약]")
        if summary.empty:
            print("해당 조건의 이벤트가 없습니다.")
        else:
            print(summary.to_string(index=False))

        if args.backtest_out:
            events.to_csv(args.backtest_out, index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
            print(f"이벤트 상세 저장 완료: {args.backtest_out}")
        if args.summary_out:
            summary.to_csv(args.summary_out, index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
            print(f"요약 저장 완료: {args.summary_out}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# 2026-11-06 공개 장중 상한가 도달 13종목 중 보통주만.

def _num(v: Any, default: float | None = None) -> float | None:
    try:
        if v is None or v == "":
            return default
        return float(str(v).replace(",", "").strip())
    except Exception:
        return default


def _ordinary(name: str) -> bool:
    s = str(name or "").strip()
    u = s.upper().replace(" ", "")
    if not s or any(t.upper() in u for t in EXCLUDE_TOKENS):
        return False
    # 사용자 운용 제외규칙: 우선주 제외. 6자리 보통주 중심.
    if re.search(r"(우|우B|우C|우선주)$", s):
        return False
    return True


def _json_safe(v: Any) -> Any:
    if isinstance(v, (np.bool_,)):
        return bool(v)
    if isinstance(v, (np.integer,)):
        return int(v)
    if isinstance(v, (np.floating,)):
        return None if not np.isfinite(v) else float(v)
    if isinstance(v, (pd.Timestamp, datetime, date)):
        return str(v)
    if isinstance(v, dict):
        return {str(k): _json_safe(x) for k, x in v.items()}
    if isinstance(v, (list, tuple)):
        return [_json_safe(x) for x in v]
    try:
        if pd.isna(v):
            return None
    except Exception:
        pass
    return v


class LSReadOnlyClient:
    """LS chart-only client. 주문/계좌 TR은 구현하지 않는다."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.app_key = os.getenv("LS_APP_KEY", "").strip()
        self.app_secret = os.getenv("LS_APP_SECRET", "").strip()
        self.base = os.getenv("LS_BASE_URL", "https://openapi.ls-sec.co.kr:8080").rstrip("/")
        self.chart_path = os.getenv("LS_CHART_PATH", "/stock/chart")
        self.timeout = max(5.0, float(os.getenv("VWAP_V11_BT_LS_TIMEOUT", "20")))
        self.interval = max(1.02, float(os.getenv("VWAP_V11_BT_LS_INTERVAL", "1.06")))
        self.session = requests.Session()
        self.token: str | None = None
        self.expire_mono = 0.0
        self.last_call_mono = 0.0
        self.lock = threading.RLock()

    @property
    def configured(self) -> bool:
        return bool(self.app_key and self.app_secret)

    def _wait(self):
        with self.lock:
            gap = time.monotonic() - self.last_call_mono
            if gap < self.interval:
                time.sleep(self.interval - gap)
            self.last_call_mono = time.monotonic()

    def _ensure_token(self):
        with self.lock:
            if self.token and time.monotonic() < self.expire_mono - 60:
                return
            if not self.configured:
                raise RuntimeError("LS_APP_KEY/LS_APP_SECRET 미설정")
            self._wait()
            # 현재 ALPHA500 provider와 동일한 OAuth 경로를 우선 사용.
            urls = [self.base + "/oauth2/token", self.base + "/oauth2/tokenP"]
            last = None
            for url in urls:
                try:
                    r = self.session.post(
                        url,
                        headers={"content-type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"},
                        data={
                            "grant_type": "client_credentials",
                            "appkey": self.app_key,
                            "appsecretkey": self.app_secret,
                            "scope": "oob",
                        },
                        timeout=self.timeout,
                    )
                    if r.status_code != 200:
                        last = f"{url} HTTP {r.status_code}: {r.text[:180]}"
                        continue
                    j = r.json()
                    token = j.get("access_token")
                    if not token:
                        last = f"token missing: {j}"
                        continue
                    self.token = str(token)
                    expires = int(j.get("expires_in") or j.get("expire_in") or 86400)
                    self.expire_mono = time.monotonic() + max(600, expires)
                    return
                except Exception as exc:
                    last = f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"
            raise RuntimeError(f"LS token failure: {last}")

    def _post(self, tr_cd: str, body: dict[str, Any], *, tr_cont: str = "N", tr_cont_key: str = ""):
        self._ensure_token()
        self._wait()
        headers = {
            "content-type": "application/json; charset=UTF-8",
            "authorization": f"Bearer {self.token}",
            "tr_cd": tr_cd,
            "tr_cont": tr_cont,
            "tr_cont_key": tr_cont_key,
        }
        mac = os.getenv("LS_MAC_ADDRESS", "").strip()
        if mac:
            headers["mac_address"] = mac
        r = self.session.post(self.base + self.chart_path, headers=headers, json=body, timeout=self.timeout)
        if r.status_code != 200:
            raise RuntimeError(f"LS {tr_cd} HTTP {r.status_code}: {r.text[:300]}")
        try:
            j = r.json()
        except Exception as exc:
            raise RuntimeError(f"LS {tr_cd} JSON decode: {exc}; body={r.text[:300]}") from exc
        rsp_cd = str(j.get("rsp_cd") or "")
        if rsp_cd and rsp_cd not in {"00000", "0000", "0"}:
            # 일부 차트 TR 정상 응답은 rsp_cd 표현이 다를 수 있어 rows 존재시 허용.
            if not (j.get(f"{tr_cd}OutBlock1") or []):
                raise RuntimeError(f"LS {tr_cd} rsp_cd={rsp_cd} msg={j.get('rsp_msg')}")
        return j, {k.lower(): v for k, v in r.headers.items()}

    def daily(self, code: str, start: date, end: date) -> pd.DataFrame:
        body = {
            "t8410InBlock": {
                "shcode": code,
                "gubun": "2",
                "qrycnt": 100,
                "sdate": start.strftime("%Y%m%d"),
                "edate": end.strftime("%Y%m%d"),
                "cts_date": "",
                "comp_yn": "N",
                "sujung": "Y",
            }
        }
        j, _ = self._post("t8410", body)
        out = []
        for z in j.get("t8410OutBlock1") or []:
            try:
                out.append({
                    "date": str(z.get("date") or ""),
                    "open": float(z.get("open") or 0),
                    "high": float(z.get("high") or 0),
                    "low": float(z.get("low") or 0),
                    "close": float(z.get("close") or 0),
                    "volume": float(z.get("jdiff_vol") or 0),
                })
            except Exception:
                continue
        return pd.DataFrame(out).sort_values("date").drop_duplicates("date") if out else pd.DataFrame()

    def minute5(self, code: str, start: date, end: date, max_pages: int = 8) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, dict[str, Any]]:
        """t8412 5분봉. 비압축 500건/회 + cts_date/cts_time 연속조회."""
        cts_date = ""
        cts_time = ""
        tr_cont_key = ""
        all_rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        pages: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        seen_cursor: set[tuple[str, str, str]] = set()

        for page in range(1, max_pages + 1):
            body = {
                "t8412InBlock": {
                    "shcode": code,
                    "ncnt": 5,
                    "qrycnt": 500,
                    "nday": "1",
                    "sdate": start.strftime("%Y%m%d"),
                    "stime": "",
                    "edate": end.strftime("%Y%m%d"),
                    "etime": "",
                    "cts_date": cts_date,
                    "cts_time": cts_time,
                    "comp_yn": "N",
                }
            }
            j, h = self._post("t8412", body, tr_cont="Y" if cts_date or cts_time else "N", tr_cont_key=tr_cont_key)
            rows = j.get("t8412OutBlock1") or []
            head = j.get("t8412OutBlock") or {}
            pages.append({
                "page": page,
                "rows": len(rows),
                "cts_date": head.get("cts_date"),
                "cts_time": head.get("cts_time"),
                "tr_cont": h.get("tr_cont"),
                "tr_cont_key_present": bool(h.get("tr_cont_key")),
                "rsp_cd": j.get("rsp_cd"),
                "rsp_msg": j.get("rsp_msg"),
            })
            for z in rows:
                try:
                    ds = str(z.get("date") or "").strip()
                    ts = "".join(ch for ch in str(z.get("time") or "") if ch.isdigit())
                    if len(ds) != 8 or len(ts) < 4:
                        continue
                    ts = (ts + "000000")[:6]
                    dt = datetime.strptime(ds + ts, "%Y%m%d%H%M%S")
                    op = float(z.get("open") or 0)
                    hi = float(z.get("high") or 0)
                    lo = float(z.get("low") or 0)
                    cl = float(z.get("close") or 0)
                    vol = float(z.get("jdiff_vol") or 0)
                    if min(op, hi, lo, cl) <= 0:
                        continue
                    # 정규장 KRX만 사용. NXT와 절대 혼합하지 않음.
                    hhmm = dt.strftime("%H%M")
                    if hhmm < "0900" or hhmm > "1530":
                        continue
                    all_rows.append({
                        "datetime": dt,
                        "date": dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
                        "time": dt.strftime("%H:%M"),
                        "open": op,
                        "high": hi,
                        "low": lo,
                        "close": cl,
                        "volume": max(0.0, vol),
                        "turnover": float(z.get("value") or 0),
                    })
                except Exception:
                    continue

            next_date = str(head.get("cts_date") or "").strip()
            next_time = str(head.get("cts_time") or "").strip()
            next_key = str(h.get("tr_cont_key") or "").strip()
            has_more = str(h.get("tr_cont") or "").upper() == "Y" or bool(next_date or next_time)
            cursor = (next_date, next_time, next_key)
            if not rows or not has_more or cursor in seen_cursor:
                break
            seen_cursor.add(cursor)
            cts_date, cts_time, tr_cont_key = next_date, next_time, next_key

        if not all_rows:
            return pd.DataFrame(), {"pages": pages, "rows": 0}
        df = pd.DataFrame(all_rows).sort_values("datetime").drop_duplicates("datetime", keep="last").reset_index(drop=True)
        mask = (df["date"] >= start.isoformat()) & (df["date"] <= end.isoformat())
        df = df[mask].reset_index(drop=True)
        return df, {"pages": pages, "rows": int(len(df)), "sessions": sorted(df["date"].unique().tolist())}


class VWAPV11LSBacktest:
    def __init__(self):
        self.lock = threading.Lock()
        self.state_lock = threading.RLock()
        self.state: dict[str, Any] = {
            "version": VERSION,
            "status": "IDLE",
            "progress": "",
            "started_at": None,
            "finished_at": None,
            "error": None,
            "summary": None,
            "details": [],
            "data_audit": {},
        }
        self.client = LSReadOnlyClient()

    def _set(self, **kw):
        with self.state_lock:
            self.state.update(kw)

    def snapshot(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        with self.state_lock:
            return _json_safe(dict(self.state))

    def _fetch_daily_public(self, ds: date) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        url = DAILY_URL.format(date=ds.strftime("%Y%m%d"))
        r = requests.get(url, timeout=25, headers={"User-Agent": "VWAP-V1.1-LS-backtest/1.0"})
        if r.status_code == 404:
            return []
        r.raise_for_status()
        txt = r.content.decode("utf-8-sig", errors="replace")
        return list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(txt)))

    def _build_events(self) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], list[dict[str, Any]]]:
        """Build the complete +20% event universe from actual published daily rows.

        2026-11-06 is no longer filled from a hand-written seed list.  The final
        trading day must also exist in the published daily file; otherwise the
        run stops rather than silently reporting a partial universe.
        """
        events: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        audit: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        d = EVENT_START
        while d <= EVENT_END:
            if d.weekday() >= 5:
                d += timedelta(days=1)
                continue
            try:
                rows = self._fetch_daily_public(d)
                if d == EVENT_END and not rows:
                    raise RuntimeError("FINAL_EVENT_DAY_DAILY_UNAVAILABLE:2026-11-06")
                n = 0
                for r in rows:
                    code = str(r.get("종목코드") or r.get("srtnCd") or "").strip().zfill(6)
                    name = str(r.get("종목명") or r.get("itmsNm") or "").strip()
                    market = str(r.get("mrktCtg") or "").strip().upper()
                    if not re.fullmatch(r"\d{6}", code) or market not in {"KOSPI", "KOSDAQ"} or not _ordinary(name):
                        continue
                    close = _num(r.get("clpr"))
                    vs = _num(r.get("vs"))
                    high = _num(r.get("hipr"))
                    if close is None or vs is None or high is None:
                        continue
                    prev_close = close - vs
                    if prev_close <= 0:
                        continue
                    peak = high / prev_close - 1.0
                    if peak >= THRESHOLD:
                        events.append({
                            "code": code, "name": name, "market": market,
                            "event_date": d.isoformat(), "prev_close": prev_close,
                            "day_high": high, "peak_pct": peak * 100.0,
                            "source": "AIK_DAILY_HIGH_ACTUAL",
                        })
                        n += 1
                audit.append({"date": d.isoformat(), "status": "OK", "rows": len(rows), "events": n})
            except Exception as exc:
                audit.append({"date": d.isoformat(), "status": "ERROR", "error": f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"})
                if d == EVENT_END:
                    raise
            d += timedelta(days=1)

        # event identity dedupe
        dedup: dict[tuple[str, str], dict[str, Any]] = {}
        for e in events:
            dedup[(e["event_date"], e["code"])] = e
        out = sorted(dedup.values(), key=lambda x: (x["event_date"], x["code"]))
        return out, audit

    @staticmethod
    def _load_engine():
        import importlib.util
        import sys
        for p in ENGINE_PATHS:
            if p.exists():
                sp = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("vwap_v11_runtime", p)
                mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(sp)
                sys.modules["vwap_v11_runtime"] = mod
                assert sp.loader is not None
                sp.loader.exec_module(mod)
                return mod, str(p)
        raise RuntimeError("VWAP V1.1 engine file not found under /app")

    @staticmethod
    def _first_true_pos(s: pd.Series) -> int | None:
        arr = np.flatnonzero(s.fillna(False).astype(bool).to_numpy())
        return int(arr[0]) if len(arr) else None

    def _evaluate_event(self, mod, bars: pd.DataFrame, event: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        code = event["code"]
        ed = event["event_date"]
        base = dict(event)
        base.update({"bars5": int(len(bars)), "sessions": int(bars["date"].nunique()) if not bars.empty else 0})
        if bars.empty or ed not in set(bars["date"]):
            return base | {"coverage": "DATA_GAP_EVENT_DAY"}
        try:
            x = mod.evaluate_signals(bars.copy(), config=mod.VWAPConfig(), session_col="date")
        except Exception as exc:
            return base | {"coverage": "ENGINE_ERROR", "error": f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"}
        day = x[x["date"] == ed].sort_values("datetime").reset_index(drop=True)
        prev_close = float(event["prev_close"])
        if day.empty or prev_close <= 0:
            return base | {"coverage": "DATA_GAP_EVENT_DAY"}

        sessions = sorted(set(x["date"]))
        prior_dates = [d for d in sessions if d < ed][-5:]
        prior = x[x["date"].isin(prior_dates)]
        base["prior_sessions_available"] = len(prior_dates)
        base["prior5_watch"] = bool(prior["explosion_watch_long"].fillna(False).any()) if not prior.empty else False
        base["prior5_action"] = bool(prior["explosion_action_long"].fillna(False).any()) if not prior.empty else False

        for pct in (0.10, 0.15, 0.20):
            lab = str(int(pct * 100))
            touch = self._first_true_pos(day["high"] >= prev_close * (1.0 + pct))
            base[f"target{lab}_reached"] = touch is not None
            if touch is None:
                for kind in ("setup", "watch", "action", "breakout_buy"):
                    base[f"pre{lab}_{kind}"] = False
                    base[f"pre{lab}_{kind}_time"] = None
                    base[f"pre{lab}_{kind}_price"] = None
                    base[f"pre{lab}_{kind}_lead_min"] = None
                continue
            touch_row = day.iloc[touch]
            base[f"target{lab}_touch_time"] = str(touch_row.get("time") or touch_row.get("datetime"))
            before = day.iloc[:touch]  # strict-before-touch: 같은 5분봉은 절대 인정하지 않음
            mapping = [
                ("setup", "explosion_setup_long"),
                ("watch", "explosion_watch_long"),
                ("action", "explosion_action_long"),
                ("breakout_buy", "action_long_breakout"),
            ]
            for kind, col in mapping:
                pos = self._first_true_pos(before[col]) if (not before.empty and col in before.columns) else None
                base[f"pre{lab}_{kind}"] = pos is not None
                if pos is None:
                    base[f"pre{lab}_{kind}_time"] = None
                    base[f"pre{lab}_{kind}_price"] = None
                    base[f"pre{lab}_{kind}_lead_min"] = None
                    continue
                r = before.iloc[pos]
                base[f"pre{lab}_{kind}_time"] = str(r.get("time") or r.get("datetime"))
                base[f"pre{lab}_{kind}_price"] = float(r["close"])
                try:
                    t0 = pd.Timestamp(r["datetime"])
                    t1 = pd.Timestamp(touch_row["datetime"])
                    base[f"pre{lab}_{kind}_lead_min"] = round((t1 - t0).total_seconds() / 60.0, 1)
                except Exception:
                    base[f"pre{lab}_{kind}_lead_min"] = None

        base["minute_peak_pct"] = (float(day["high"].max()) / prev_close - 1.0) * 100.0
        base["coverage"] = "A_FULL_PRIOR5" if len(prior_dates) >= 5 else "B_EVENT_DAY_PARTIAL_PRIOR"
        return base

    @staticmethod
    def _metric(rows: list[dict[str, Any]], col: str, usable: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        hits = [r for r in usable if bool(r.get(col))]
        lead_key = col + "_lead_min"
        leads = [float(r[lead_key]) for r in hits if r.get(lead_key) is not None]
        return {
            "metric": col,
            "n": len(usable),
            "hits": len(hits),
            "recall_pct": round(100.0 * len(hits) / len(usable), 2) if usable else None,
            "avg_lead_min": round(float(np.mean(leads)), 1) if leads else None,
            "median_lead_min": round(float(np.median(leads)), 1) if leads else None,
        }

    def run(self):
        if not self.lock.acquire(blocking=False):
            return
        try:
            started = datetime.now(KST).isoformat()
            self._set(status="RUNNING", progress="event universe", started_at=started, finished_at=None, error=None, summary=None, details=[], data_audit={})
            mod, engine_path = self._load_engine()
            events, daily_audit = self._build_events()
            if not events:
                raise RuntimeError("+20% event universe empty")
            by_code: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)
            for e in events:
                by_code[e["code"]].append(e)

            details: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
            minute_audit: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
            source_counts = Counter()
            for i, (code, es) in enumerate(sorted(by_code.items()), 1):
                self._set(progress=f"LS t8412 {i}/{len(by_code)} {code} {es[0]['name']}")
                try:
                    bars, audit = self.client.minute5(code, FETCH_START, FETCH_END)
                    source_counts["LS_T8412"] += 1
                    minute_audit.append({"code": code, "name": es[0]["name"], **audit})
                except Exception as exc:
                    bars = pd.DataFrame()
                    minute_audit.append({"code": code, "name": es[0]["name"], "error": f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"})
                for e in es:
                    details.append(self._evaluate_event(mod, bars, e))

            usable = [r for r in details if r.get("coverage") in {"A_FULL_PRIOR5", "B_EVENT_DAY_PARTIAL_PRIOR"}]
            full_prior = [r for r in details if r.get("coverage") == "A_FULL_PRIOR5"]
            metrics: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
            for lab in ("10", "15", "20"):
                for kind in ("setup", "watch", "action", "breakout_buy"):
                    metrics.append(self._metric(details, f"pre{lab}_{kind}", usable))
            metrics.append(self._metric(details, "prior5_watch", full_prior))
            metrics.append(self._metric(details, "prior5_action", full_prior))

            # 종목별 중복 이벤트 과대가중 방지: 각 종목 첫 이벤트만.
            first: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
            for r in sorted(usable, key=lambda x: (x.get("event_date") or "", x.get("code") or "")):
                first.setdefault(str(r.get("code")), r)
            first_rows = list(first.values())
            first_metrics = [self._metric(details, f"pre20_{k}", first_rows) for k in ("setup", "watch", "action", "breakout_buy")]

            summary = {
                "version": VERSION,
                "engine_path": engine_path,
                "period": [EVENT_START.isoformat(), EVENT_END.isoformat()],
                "fetch_period": [FETCH_START.isoformat(), FETCH_END.isoformat()],
                "universe_rule": "KOSPI/KOSDAQ ordinary common stocks; ETF/ETN/preferred/SPAC/REIT excluded; no market-cap floor",
                "event_rule": "regular-session high / previous regular close - 1 >= 20%",
                "strict_rule": "signal must be confirmed on a completed 5m bar strictly before the first target-touch 5m bar; same-bar signal is not a hit",
                "daily_event_count": len(events),
                "daily_unique_stocks": len(by_code),
                "minute_usable_events": len(usable),
                "minute_coverage_pct": round(100.0 * len(usable) / len(events), 2) if events else None,
                "full_prior5_events": len(full_prior),
                "data_gap_events": len(events) - len(usable),
                "metrics_event_level": metrics,
                "metrics_first_event_per_stock_pre20": first_metrics,
                "minute_source_counts": dict(source_counts),
                "completed_at": datetime.now(KST).isoformat(),
            }
            RESULT_ROOT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            run_id = datetime.now(KST).strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
            outdir = RESULT_ROOT / run_id
            outdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            pd.DataFrame(details).to_csv(outdir / "detail.csv", index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
            pd.DataFrame(metrics).to_csv(outdir / "summary.csv", index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
            (outdir / "report.json").write_text(json.dumps(_json_safe(summary), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
            (outdir / "daily_audit.json").write_text(json.dumps(_json_safe(daily_audit), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
            (outdir / "minute_audit.json").write_text(json.dumps(_json_safe(minute_audit), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
            # latest pointer (copy by text/csv, symlink 불필요)
            (RESULT_ROOT / "latest_report.json").write_text(json.dumps(_json_safe(summary), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
            pd.DataFrame(details).to_csv(RESULT_ROOT / "latest_detail.csv", index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
            self._set(
                status="READY", progress="done", finished_at=datetime.now(KST).isoformat(),
                summary=summary, details=details,
                data_audit={"daily": daily_audit, "minute": minute_audit, "output_dir": str(outdir)},
            )
            print("VWAP_V11_LS_BACKTEST_READY " + json.dumps(_json_safe(summary), ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
        except Exception as exc:
            self._set(status="ERROR", finished_at=datetime.now(KST).isoformat(), error=f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}\n{traceback.format_exc()[-5000:]}")
            print("VWAP_V11_LS_BACKTEST_ERROR " + str(exc), flush=True)
        finally:
            self.lock.release()

    def trigger(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        if self.lock.locked() or self.snapshot().get("status") == "RUNNING":
            return {"accepted": False, "reason": "ALREADY_RUNNING", "state": self.snapshot()}
        threading.Thread(target=self.run, daemon=True, name="vwap-v11-ls-backtest").start()
        return {"accepted": True, "version": VERSION, "status": "STARTING"}

    def handle_get(self, raw_path: str):
        u = urlparse(raw_path)
        path = u.path
        qs = parse_qs(u.query)
        if path == "/api/research/vwap-v11/health":
            s = self.snapshot()
            return 200, {
                "ok": s.get("status") != "ERROR",
                "version": VERSION,
                "status": s.get("status"),
                "progress": s.get("progress"),
                "ls_configured": self.client.configured,
                "policy": "READ_ONLY_MANUAL_TRIGGER__NO_ORDER__NO_MAIN_ENGINE_MUTATION",
            }
        if path == "/api/research/vwap-v11/run":
            return 202, self.trigger()
        if path == "/api/research/vwap-v11/result":
            s = self.snapshot()
            include_details = str((qs.get("details") or ["0"])[0]).lower() in {"1", "true", "yes"}
            if not include_details:
                s.pop("details", None)
                if isinstance(s.get("data_audit"), dict):
                    s["data_audit"] = {"output_dir": s["data_audit"].get("output_dir")}
            return 200, s
        if path == "/api/research/vwap-v11/detail":
            s = self.snapshot()
            limit = max(1, min(int((qs.get("limit") or ["500"])[0]), 5000))
            return 200, {"status": s.get("status"), "rows": (s.get("details") or [])[:limit]}
        return None


VWAP_V11_BACKTEST = VWAPV11LSBacktest()

# Runtime-only optional one-shot autorun. Docker build smoke tests leave this disabled;
# the final Dockerfile enables it only after compilation/patch tests complete.
def _autorun_once_runtime():
    enabled = str(os.getenv("VWAP_V11_BT_AUTORUN_ON_IMPORT", "false")).strip().lower() in {"1","true","yes","on"}
    if not enabled:
        return
    marker = RESULT_ROOT / "AUTORUN_20261026_20261106_DONE.json"
    if marker.exists():
        print("VWAP_V11_LS_BACKTEST_AUTORUN_SKIP marker_exists=" + str(marker), flush=True)
        return
    def _job():
        try:
            time.sleep(max(2.0, float(os.getenv("VWAP_V11_BT_AUTORUN_DELAY", "12"))))
            VWAP_V11_BACKTEST.run()
            s = VWAP_V11_BACKTEST.snapshot()
            if s.get("status") == "READY":
                RESULT_ROOT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                marker.write_text(json.dumps({
                    "version": VERSION,
                    "finished_at": s.get("finished_at"),
                    "summary": s.get("summary"),
                }, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str), encoding="utf-8")
        except Exception as exc:
            print("VWAP_V11_LS_BACKTEST_AUTORUN_ERROR " + f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}", flush=True)
    threading.Thread(target=_job, daemon=True, name="vwap-v11-ls-autorun-once").start()

_autorun_once_runtime()
